export function tickOxygen(state: GameState, dt: number, applyDamage: (amount: number) => void, waterBreathing = false): void {
  if (waterBreathing) {
    state.oxygen = MAX_OXYGEN;
    timers.drownTimer = 0;
    return;
  }
  const x = Math.floor(player.position.x);
  const headY = Math.floor(player.position.y + EYE_HEIGHT);
  const z = Math.floor(player.position.z);
  if (world.get(x, headY, z) === BlockId.Water) {
    state.oxygen = Math.max(0, state.oxygen - (MAX_OXYGEN / OXYGEN_HOLD_SECONDS) * dt);
    if (state.oxygen > 0) {
      timers.drownTimer = 0;
      return;
    }
    timers.drownTimer += dt;
    while (timers.drownTimer >= OXYGEN_DROWN_INTERVAL_SECONDS && !state.isDead) {
      timers.drownTimer -= OXYGEN_DROWN_INTERVAL_SECONDS;
      applyDamage(OXYGEN_DROWN_HP);  // Line 165: GATE THIS
    }
    return;
  }
  state.oxygen = Math.min(MAX_OXYGEN, state.oxygen + (MAX_OXYGEN / OXYGEN_REFILL_SECONDS) * dt);
  timers.drownTimer = 0;
}
```
**Gate:** Wrap `applyDamage(OXYGEN_DROWN_HP)` in `if (state.gameMode !== "creative")`. Also set `state.oxygen = MAX_OXYGEN` at the top for creative (no drain).

export function applyDamageWithArmor(state: GameState, amount: number, rng?: () => number): boolean {
  if (state.isDead) return false;
  const value = Math.max(0, Math.floor(amount));
  if (value <= 0) return false;
  
  // ... armor & durability ...
  
  state.hearts = Math.max(0, state.hearts - mitigated);
  if (state.hearts > 0) return false;
  
  state.isDead = true;  // DEATH TRIGGER
  state.respawnTimer = RESPAWN_SECONDS;
  return true;
}

export function applyUnmitigatedDamage(state: GameState, amount: number): boolean {
  if (state.isDead) return false;
  const value = Math.max(0, Math.floor(amount));
  if (value <= 0) return false;
  
  state.hearts = Math.max(0, state.hearts - value);
  if (state.hearts > 0) return false;
  
  state.isDead = true;  // DEATH TRIGGER
  state.respawnTimer = RESPAWN_SECONDS;
  return true;
}
```

## My take: yes — add a Creative mode

Of the "game modes" Minecraft has, **Creative** is the one worth building. It roughly doubles who the game is for (builders, not just survivalists), it's the single most-requested companion to Survival, and — importantly — **your engine already has the exact template for it.** This isn't a rearchitecture; it's a well-isolated addition.

**Why it's clean here:**

1. **There's a proven pattern to copy.** Your `worldType` (Default/Superflat/…) is already a per-world enum chosen at creation, stored on `WorldMeta`, persisted in the save (additive field + migration), and read by the engine at boot. A `gameMode: "survival" | "creative"` field rides the *exact same rails* — `lib/world/` type + validator, `lib/game/worlds.ts` preset list, a `SaveData` v7→v8 additive migration, `GameEngine` constructor field, and a picker in `CreateWorldForm.tsx`.

2. **Every survival mechanic funnels through a clean seam.** Creative = gate ~15 well-defined points behind `gameMode !== "creative"`: no fall/void/lava/water/drown damage and no hunger drain (`playerStats.ts`/`playerMotion.ts`), no death (`playerLife.ts`), instant block break with no drops/durability (`mining.ts`), no item consumption on placement (the single `adjustSlotCount` call in `placeSelectedBlock`), and no hostile spawns/aggro/damage (`spawnDirector.ts`, `mobAI.ts`, `projectileAI.ts`). The damage sources are already centralized — they're easy to switch off as a group.

3. **The two genuinely new pieces are small and self-contained:** *flight* (double-tap space to toggle, space/crouch to ascend/descend — a branch in `playerMotion.ts`'s gravity block + a `toggleFlight` in `inputController.ts`), and a *creative inventory palette* (a tab listing all of `ITEM_DEFS` grouped by kind, click-to-grab — reusing the existing slot grid in `InventoryPanel.tsx`).

So: **medium effort, no rearchitecture, fully additive to the save format.** I'd build Creative rather than a scatter of smaller "types."

> AGENT

Good question — and the answer actually clarifies the cleanest design. Let me answer it precisely, because real Minecraft splits this across **two axes**, which resolves the "are Peaceful/Hardcore really modes?" tension neatly.

## How real Minecraft handles it

- **Game mode** (Survival / Creative / Adventure / Spectator): **switchable in-game** — but only if that world has "Allow Cheats" on (via the `/gamemode` command or the F3+F4 switcher). It's set at world creation and can be changed later.
- **Difficulty** (Peaceful / Easy / Normal / Hard): **always switchable in-game** from the Options menu, no cheats needed. So **Peaceful is a *difficulty*, not a game mode.**
- **Hardcore**: a **permanent world flag** chosen at creation, locked to Hard difficulty — death is final (the world is locked/deleted). **Not switchable.**

## The model I'd adopt (faithful + clean)

So your "Creative + Hardcore + Peaceful" maps onto two axes plus a flag — and this is *simpler* than cramming all three into one enum:

| Axis | Values | Switchable? |
|---|---|---|
| **Game mode** | Survival ⇄ Creative | **Yes** — in the pause menu |
| **Difficulty** | Normal ⇄ Peaceful | **Yes** — in the pause menu |
| **Hardcore** | on/off | **No** — fixed at creation (forces Survival; death deletes the world) |

This honors all three of your picks, matches Minecraft's switchability (mode + difficulty live; hardcore permanent), and reuses your existing per-world plumbing. I'll skip a "cheats" gate — it's single-player, so mode is just freely switchable in the pause menu, with the one exception that **Hardcore worlds lock mode and difficulty** (that's the whole point of hardcore).

  "content": "# Game Modes: Creative, Hardcore & Peaceful\n\n## Context\n\nmonecraft is survival-only. We're adding game modes, modeled faithfully on real Minecraft, which splits this across **two switchable axes plus one permanent flag**:\n\n- **Game mode** — `Survival ⇄ Creative` (switchable in the pause menu)\n- **Difficulty** — `Normal ⇄ Peaceful` (switchable in the pause menu)\n- **Hardcore** — a permanent per-world flag set at creation (forces Survival + Normal; death deletes the world)\n\nThis honors the user's choice of \"Creative + Hardcore + Peaceful,\" matches Minecraft's switchability (mode & difficulty live, hardcore permanent), and reuses the existing per-world `worldType` plumbing as its template. **Zero new assets.** Save schema bumps **v7 → v8 (additive)** — no worldgen change.\n\nSingle-player, so there's no \"cheats\" gate: mode/difficulty switch freely in the pause menu. The one exception: a **Hardcore world locks both** (no switching — that's the point).\n\nThis is a sizable, cross-cutting feature → it lands on a branch `feat/game-modes` in focused commit slices (data model → Creative → Hardcore → Peaceful → in-game switching → UI/HUD → docs/tests), keeping `bun run lint` green at each slice.\n\n## Data model & plumbing (copy the `worldType` pattern exactly)\n\n`worldType` is the proven template: a per-world enum, validated, stored on `WorldMeta`, persisted in `SaveData` (additive + migration), read by `GameEngine` at boot, picked in `CreateWorldForm`. We mirror it.\n\n1. **New `lib/game/gameModes.ts`** — `GameMode = \"survival\" | \"creative\"`, `Difficulty = \"normal\" | \"peaceful\"`, plus `isGameMode`/`isDifficulty` validators and `GAME_MODE_PRESETS` / `DIFFICULTY_PRESETS` (`{ id, label, blurb }`) for the pickers (parallels `WORLD_TYPE_PRESETS` in `lib/game/worlds.ts`).\n2. **`WorldMeta`** (`lib/game/worlds.ts`): add `gameMode`, `difficulty`, `hardcore: boolean` — the *creation-time* values (for first boot before a save exists + world-card badges). Extend `sanitizeWorld` (coerce unknown → `survival`/`normal`/`false`) and `createWorld` deps, exactly like `worldType`.\n3. **`SaveData` v8** (`lib/game/types.ts`): `SaveDataV8 = Omit<SaveDataV7,\"version\"> & { version: 8; gameMode?: GameMode; difficulty?: Difficulty; hardcore?: boolean }`. The *current* (possibly-switched) values are authoritative here.\n4. **Migration** (`lib/game/save.ts`): `migrateSaveV7toV8` = pure bump; extend the `readSave` chain and point `SaveData` at v8.\n5. **`GameEngine`** (`GameEngine.ts`): add `gameMode`/`difficulty`/`hardcore` to `GameEngineOptions`; constructor resolves `save ?? options ?? default` (save wins on restore, like `worldType`); `serialize()` writes all three.\n6. **`GameState`** (`lib/game/engine/state.ts`): add `gameMode`, `difficulty`, `hardcore`, and transient `isFlying: boolean`. Expose `gameMode`/`difficulty`/`hardcore`/`isFlying` on the React snapshot so the HUD/menus can read them.\n\n## Creative mode — gate the survival seams behind `gameMode === \"creative\"`\n\nThe damage/consume seams are already centralized; Creative switches them off as a group. Gate points (all confirmed in exploration):\n\n- **No damage / no hunger** — `lib/game/engine/systems/playerStats.ts`: skip `tickHungerDrain`, force full health in `tickHealthRegen`, and gate the `applyDamage(...)` calls in `tickWaterExposure`/`tickLavaExposure`/`tickOxygen`. `playerMotion.ts`: gate fall-damage (~L127) and void-damage (~L134).\n- **No death** — `lib/game/engine/systems/playerLife.ts`: early-`return false` in `applyDamageWithArmor` + `applyUnmitigatedDamage` when creative.\n- **Instant build, no drops, no durability** — `mining.ts`: in `tickMining`, skip the hardness accumulation (break immediately) and gate `addBlockDrop`/`consumeToolDurability`.\n- **No item consumption on placement** — `mining.ts` `placeSelectedBlock`: gate the single `adjustSlotCount(..., -1, ...)` decrement.\n- **Flight** — `playerMotion.ts`: when `isFlying`, replace the gravity block with vertical control (Space = ascend, crouch = descend, else hover at `velocity.y = 0`) at `FLY_SPEED`. `inputController.ts`: double-tap **Space** (≤300 ms) dispatches `toggleFlight` (creative only; ignored otherwise). Entering survival forces `isFlying = false`.\n- **No hostiles** — shared with Peaceful below.\n\n**Creative inventory palette** — a new tab in `components/game/InventoryPanel.tsx` listing all of `ITEM_DEFS` (from `lib/game/items.ts`) grouped by `kind`, reusing the existing `inv-grid` slot buttons; click an item → `adjustSlotCount(+stack, preferredSlot)` (use `createSlot`). Add a small search/filter box. Shown when `gameMode === \"creative\"` in place of the recipe book.\n\n## Hardcore — permanent permadeath flag\n\n- Fixed at creation; forces `gameMode = \"survival\"`, `difficulty = \"normal\"`, and is **not switchable**.\n- On death in a hardcore world: **do not respawn** — instead the engine leaves `isDead` set and surfaces it; the React shell (`useMinecraftGame.ts` / `GameShell.tsx`) detects `isDead && hardcore`, shows a \"Game Over\" screen, calls the existing `deleteWorld(...)` (`lib/game/worlds.ts`), and returns to the world-select menu. Gate `tickRespawnTimer` so it never auto-revives a hardcore player.\n- World-card badge: \"Hardcore\" (e.g. tinted). Optionally tint the HUD hearts.\n\n## Peaceful — a difficulty (no hostiles), shares Creative's spawn gate\n\n- Gate hostile spawning in `spawnDirector.ts` (`tickHostileSpawnDirector` + the dungeon `tickSpawnerDirector`): early-return when `difficulty === \"peaceful\"` **or** `gameMode === \"creative\"`.\n- Clear/despawn existing hostiles on entering Peaceful (so night turns safe immediately).\n- monecraft hunger doesn't deal starvation damage today (it only gates regen), so no extra hunger handling is needed for Peaceful.\n\n## In-game switching (pause menu) + state-reset on switch\n\n- Pause menu (the existing pause component with Save & Quit / volume) gains a **Game Mode** selector (Survival/Creative) and **Difficulty** selector (Normal/Peaceful). Both are **hidden/locked for hardcore worlds**.\n- New engine commands `setGameMode` / `setDifficulty`. On switch, reset transient state so no queued damage or stuck flight leaks across:\n  - → Creative: `isFlying = false`, hearts/hunger forced full, and reset the lava/void/water/drown timers in `state.timers`.\n  - → Survival: `isFlying = false` (gravity resumes, player falls), hearts/hunger restored to full, same timer reset.\n  - → Peaceful/Normal: clear hostiles on entering Peaceful; nothing special re-entering Normal.\n\n## UI surfaces\n\n- `components/menu/CreateWorldForm.tsx`: add a game-mode grid + difficulty grid + a hardcore toggle, mirroring the existing `world-type-grid` markup. Thread choices through `WorldSelect.onCreate` → `createWorld({ gameMode, difficulty, hardcore })`.\n- `components/menu/WorldSelect.tsx`: world cards show mode/difficulty/hardcore badges (like the current `worldType` sub-label).\n- HUD (`components/game/*`): hide hearts + hunger bars in Creative; show a subtle \"Creative\" / flying indicator; hardcore heart tint.\n- Pause menu component: the two selectors above.\n\n## Config tunables (`lib/game/config.ts`)\n\n- `FLY_SPEED` (≈12–16 blocks/s) and `FLY_DOUBLE_TAP_WINDOW_SECONDS` (0.3). Group under a new \"Game modes / creative flight\" comment block.\n\n## Representative files to modify\n\nNew: `lib/game/gameModes.ts`, `components/game/CreativeInventoryTab.tsx` (or inline in `InventoryPanel.tsx`).\nEdited: `lib/game/types.ts`, `lib/game/save.ts`, `lib/game/worlds.ts`, `lib/game/engine/state.ts`, `lib/game/engine/GameEngine.ts`, `lib/game/useMinecraftGame.ts`, `lib/game/config.ts`, `lib/game/input/inputController.ts`, systems `playerMotion.ts` / `playerStats.ts` / `playerLife.ts` / `mining.ts` / `spawnDirector.ts` / `mobAI.ts` / `projectileAI.ts`, and components `CreateWorldForm.tsx` / `WorldSelect.tsx` / `InventoryPanel.tsx` / the pause menu / HUD.\n\n## Tests (`*.test.ts`, colocated)\n\n- Save migration `v7 → v8` (pure bump; old save loads as survival/normal/non-hardcore).\n- Creative gates: no damage from lava/void/fall/water/drown, no death, instant break, no drop, no durability loss, no item consumed on placement.\n- Flight: `toggleFlight` only flips in creative; ascend/descend changes `velocity.y`; entering survival clears `isFlying`.\n- Hardcore: death sets `isDead` and does **not** respawn; the shell signal is exposed.\n- Peaceful: `tickHostileSpawnDirector` no-ops at night; existing hostiles cleared on switch.\n- Mode/difficulty switch resets timers + hearts/hunger.\n- Update `config.test.ts` integrity (new enums/presets exhaustive; `ITEM_DEFS` palette coverage).\n\n## Docs (ship with the change — part of the gate)\n\n- `docs/manual.md`: new \"Game Modes\" section (Creative/flight/palette, Hardcore, Peaceful, switching).\n- `docs/reference.md`: a modes/difficulty table.\n- `docs/save-format.md`: v8 fields + migration.\n- `docs/tuning.md`: `FLY_SPEED` / double-tap window.\n- `README.md`: fly controls (double-tap Space, Space/crouch).\n- `CHANGELOG.md`: add to `[Unreleased]`.\n\n## Verification\n\n- Gate: `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run format:check`, `bun test`, `bun run build` green; `bun run test:e2e` (touches input + React shell).\n- Manual pass (per docs/testing.md, since input/visuals change): create a **Creative** world → double-tap Space to fly, build from the palette with no item loss, stand in lava/jump off a cliff and take no damage, confirm hearts/hunger hidden. Create a **Hardcore** world → die and confirm the world is deleted and you return to the menu. Create a **Peaceful** world → confirm no hostiles spawn at night. > AGENT

Agreed — if we're modeling on Minecraft, follow its actual four game modes rather than inventing our own set. I've redesigned around that. Here's my thinking, then the rewritten plan.

## The four modes, mapped to monecraft

The clean structure is: **one `gameMode` axis with four values**, plus the two orthogonal things Minecraft keeps *separate* from game mode — **Difficulty** (where Peaceful lives) and the **Hardcore** flag. So your earlier Creative/Hardcore/Peaceful picks all still land; they just sit on their correct axes.

| Behavior | Survival | Creative | Adventure | Spectator |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Damage / hunger / death | yes | **no** | yes | **no** |
| Break blocks | yes | instant, no drop | **no** | no |
| Place blocks | yes (consumes) | **no consume** | **no** | no |
| Flight | no | yes | no | **noclip** (pass through blocks) |
| Terrain collision | yes | yes | yes | **no** |
| Interact (doors/chests/trade/attack/eat/fish) | yes | yes | yes | **no** |
| Mobs threaten you | yes | no | yes | no |
| Inventory | normal | all-items palette | normal | hidden |

Plus **Hardcore** (survival + permadeath, fixed at creation) and **Peaceful** (difficulty: no hostile spawns, switchable).

## My honest take on the four

- **Creative** — the big win; do this well.
- **Spectator** — genuinely fun here (free-cam noclip flythrough of your world). Most new code: noclip = *disable terrain collision*, plus block all interaction and render the player translucent.
- **Adventure** — faithful to include, but **low value in single-player**: its whole purpose is locking block editing on *shared custom maps*, which this game doesn't have. The upside: it's nearly free — just gate break + place on top of survival. I'd keep it for completeness but it's the one I'd cut first if you want leaner scope.

I'm keeping the implementation clean with mode **predicates** (`takesDamage`, `canEditBlocks`, `canInteract`, `canFly`, `isNoclip`) in one file, so each system gates on intent rather than scattering `mode === "x"` checks. This is now a sizable feature, so the plan sequences it into reviewable slices.

I've rewritten the plan:

- They're genuinely separate axes in Minecraft, so dropping them now doesn't compromise the design — the `gameMode` enum is self-contained, and difficulty/hardcore slot in cleanly later.
- It keeps this closer to your usual one-PR scope, and avoids the riskiest piece (Hardcore's permadeath → delete-world flow touches the death/respawn path and the menu shell).

So this phase = `Survival · Creative · Adventure · Spectator`, switchable in the pause menu. Save adds just one field (`gameMode`). I've trimmed the plan accordingly and left a "next time" note for difficulty + hardcore.

Adventure is the cheapest, lowest-value mode (its purpose — locking block edits on shared custom maps — barely applies to a single-player game) but nearly free once the predicate gates exist.\n\n## Mode behavior matrix\n\n| Behavior | Survival | Creative | Adventure | Spectator |\n|---|---|---|---|---|\n| Damage / hunger / death | ✓ | ✕ | ✓ | ✕ |\n| Break blocks | ✓ | instant, no drop/durability | ✕ | ✕ |\n| Place blocks | ✓ (consumes) | ✓ (no consume) | ✕ | ✕ |\n| Flight | ✕ | ✓ | ✕ | ✓ noclip |\n| Terrain collision | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✕ |\n| Interact (door/chest/trade/attack/eat/fish) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✕ |\n| Mobs threaten player | ✓ | ✕ | ✓ | ✕ |\n| Inventory | normal | all-items palette | normal | hidden |\n| Player render | solid | solid | solid | translucent |\n\n## Mode predicates (the core abstraction)\n\nNew `lib/game/gameModes.ts` — `GameMode = \"survival\" | \"creative\" | \"adventure\" | \"spectator\"`, an `isGameMode` validator, and `GAME_MODE_PRESETS` (`{ id, label, blurb }`, parallel to `WORLD_TYPE_PRESETS` in `lib/game/worlds.ts`). Plus intent predicates each system gates on (so no scattered string compares):\n\n- `takesDamage(mode)` = survival | adventure\n- `canEditBlocks(mode)` = survival | creative (adventure & spectator: false)\n- `freeBuild(mode)` = creative (instant break, no drop, no consume)\n- `canInteract(mode)` = mode !== spectator\n- `canFly(mode)` = creative | spectator\n- `isNoclip(mode)` = spectator\n- `usesInventory(mode)` = mode !== spectator\n- `mobsThreaten(mode)` = survival | adventure\n\n## Data model & plumbing (copy the `worldType` pattern)\n\n`worldType` is the proven per-world-enum template (validator → `WorldMeta` → `SaveData` additive + migration → `GameEngine` boot → `CreateWorldForm`). Mirror it for `gameMode`:\n\n1. **`WorldMeta`** (`lib/game/worlds.ts`): add `gameMode` (creation-time value for first boot + world-card badge); extend `sanitizeWorld` (unknown → `survival`) and `createWorld` deps.\n2. **`SaveData` v8** (`lib/game/types.ts`): `SaveDataV8 = Omit<SaveDataV7,\"version\"> & { version: 8; gameMode?: GameMode }` — the authoritative *current* value (may have been switched in-game).\n3. **Migration** (`lib/game/save.ts`): `migrateSaveV7toV8` pure bump; extend the `readSave` chain; repoint `SaveData` to v8.\n4. **`GameEngine`** (`GameEngine.ts`): add `gameMode` to `GameEngineOptions`; resolve `save ?? options ?? \"survival\"` (save wins on restore, like `worldType`); `serialize()` writes it.\n5. **`GameState`** (`engine/state.ts`): add `gameMode` and transient `isFlying`; expose both on the React snapshot for HUD/menus.\n\n## Creative — gate via predicates\n\n- **No damage / hunger / death** — `playerStats.ts` (`tickHungerDrain` skip; `tickHealthRegen` force full; gate `applyDamage` in water/lava/oxygen ticks), `playerMotion.ts` (fall + void damage), `playerLife.ts` (`applyDamageWithArmor`/`applyUnmitigatedDamage` early-return) — all gated on `!takesDamage(mode)`.\n- **Free build** — `mining.ts` `tickMining`: when `freeBuild`, break instantly, skip `addBlockDrop` + `consumeToolDurability`; `placeSelectedBlock`: skip the `adjustSlotCount(-1)` decrement.\n- **Flight** — `playerMotion.ts`: when `isFlying`, replace gravity with vertical control (Space ascend / crouch descend / hover) at `FLY_SPEED`. `inputController.ts`: double-tap Space → `toggleFlight` when `canFly`.\n- **All-items palette** — new tab in `components/game/InventoryPanel.tsx` listing `ITEM_DEFS` grouped by `kind` (reuse `inv-grid` buttons + `createSlot`/`adjustSlotCount`), with a search box; shown when `gameMode === \"creative\"`.\n\n## Spectator — noclip free-cam\n\n- **Always flying, noclip** — `playerMotion.ts`: when `isNoclip`, skip the terrain collision-resolution/depenetration step and integrate position straight from velocity; force `isFlying` true, never grounded; reuse the Creative fly controls.\n- **Invulnerable / no hunger / no death** — same `!takesDamage` gates as Creative.\n- **No interaction at all** — gate world-affecting commands in `GameEngine.dispatch` and `tickMining` behind `canInteract`: mining, placing, attack, use/eat/fish/trade/interact all no-op; only movement, camera, pause, and the mode menu remain.\n- **Mobs ignore the player** — `mobAI.ts`/`projectileAI.ts`/`spawnDirector.ts` gate aggro + player-damage on `mobsThreaten(mode)` (false for Creative & Spectator).\n- **Translucent player** — renderer: when spectator, draw the player model semi-transparent (or hidden in third-person); first-person unchanged. Hide the hotbar/HUD bars.\n\n## Adventure — survival minus terrain editing\n\nIdentical to Survival (damage, hunger, mobs, combat, doors/chests/trade/eat/fish all work) **except block break + place are disabled** — covered by the `canEditBlocks` gate already added to `tickMining` (break) and `placeSelectedBlock`. No flight, normal HUD. Essentially free once the predicate gates exist.\n\n## In-game switching + state reset\n\n- Pause menu gains a **Game Mode** selector (4 options) using `GAME_MODE_PRESETS`.\n- New `setGameMode` engine command. On switch, reset transient state so nothing leaks:\n  - Entering a no-damage mode (Creative/Spectator): hearts/hunger forced full; reset lava/void/water/drown timers in `state.timers`.\n  - Entering Spectator: `isFlying = true`, noclip on. Leaving Spectator: snap out of any solid block (reuse the existing auto-unstuck depenetration), `isFlying = false`.\n  - Entering Survival/Adventure: `isFlying = false` (gravity resumes); restore full hearts/hunger.\n\n## UI surfaces\n\n- `components/menu/CreateWorldForm.tsx`: a 4-option game-mode grid mirroring the existing `world-type-grid` markup; thread through `WorldSelect.onCreate` → `createWorld({ gameMode })`.\n- `components/menu/WorldSelect.tsx`: a world-card mode badge (like the current `worldType` sub-label).\n- HUD (`components/game/*`): hide hearts + hunger in Creative/Spectator; hide the hotbar in Spectator; small \"Creative\"/\"Spectator\"/flying indicator.\n- Pause menu: the mode selector.\n\n## Config tunables (`lib/game/config.ts`)\n\n`FLY_SPEED` (≈12–16) and `FLY_DOUBLE_TAP_WINDOW_SECONDS` (0.3), under a new \"Game modes / flight\" group.\n\n## Representative files\n\nNew: `lib/game/gameModes.ts`, `components/game/CreativeInventoryTab.tsx` (or inline).\nEdited: `lib/game/types.ts`, `save.ts`, `worlds.ts`, `engine/state.ts`, `engine/GameEngine.ts`, `useMinecraftGame.ts`, `config.ts`, `input/inputController.ts`; systems `playerMotion.ts` / `playerStats.ts` / `playerLife.ts` / `mining.ts` / `spawnDirector.ts` / `mobAI.ts` / `projectileAI.ts`; the player renderer; components `CreateWorldForm.tsx` / `WorldSelect.tsx` / `InventoryPanel.tsx` / pause menu / HUD.\n\n## Tests (colocated `*.test.ts`)\n\n- Migration `v7 → v8` (old save loads as `survival`).\n- Predicates table (each mode's flags).\n- Creative: no damage, instant break, no drop/durability, no consume on place; palette inserts.\n- Spectator: noclip (moves through a solid block), invulnerable, all interaction commands no-op, mobs don't aggro.\n- Adventure: damage still applies; break + place blocked; combat/interaction still work.\n- Flight: `toggleFlight` only when `canFly`; ascend/descend change `velocity.y`.\n- Switch resets timers + hearts/hunger + noclip exit. Update `config.test.ts` integrity (exhaustive presets, `ITEM_DEFS` palette coverage).\n\n## Docs (ship with the change — part of the gate)\n\n`docs/manual.md` (new \"Game Modes\" section: the four modes, flight, palette, switching), `docs/reference.md` (modes table), `docs/save-format.md` (v8 field + migration), `docs/tuning.md` (`FLY_SPEED` + double-tap), `README.md` (fly controls), `CHANGELOG.md` (`[Unreleased]`).\n\n## Verification\n\n- Gate: `bun run lint`, `typecheck`, `format:check`, `bun test`, `bun run build` green; `bun run test:e2e` (touches input + shell).\n- Manual pass (input/visual change): **Creative** — fly (double-tap Space), build from palette with no item loss, take no damage, hearts/hunger hidden. **Spectator** — fly through terrain, can't break/interact, mobs ignore you, player translucent. **Adventure** — take damage and fight mobs, but can't break/place blocks. **Switching** — flip modes in the pause menu and confirm clean state resets (flight off, HUD restored, no queued damage).\n\n## Next time (deferred)\n\n- **Difficulty axis** (`Normal ⇄ Peaceful`) — switchable; Peaceful gates hostile spawns. The `mobsThreaten`/spawn gates added here are the hook it plugs into.\n- **Hardcore** world flag — one life; death deletes the world (touches respawn + the menu-shell `deleteWorld` flow).\n- Other candidates still open: companions & taming, advancements & goals, building & decoration, water & exploration.\n"
}

## Approved Plan:
# Game Modes — Minecraft's four modes

## Context

monecraft is survival-only. We're adding Minecraft's four game modes as a single, self-contained axis: **Survival · Creative · Adventure · Spectator**, switchable in the pause menu. **Zero new assets.** Save schema bumps **v7 → v8** with one additive field (`gameMode`); no worldgen change. Single-player, so mode switches freely (no "cheats" gate).

**Deferred to a follow-up (explicitly out of scope now):** the **Difficulty** axis (`Peaceful`) and the **Hardcore** world flag (permadeath). They're orthogonal axes in Minecraft and drop in cleanly later — keeping them out now avoids touching the death/respawn + menu-shell deletion path and keeps this a focused change.

**Scope:** sizable but contained. Per AGENTS.md this is "big work" → it gets its own branch and lands as one reviewable PR (not straight to `main`). Adventure is the cheapest, lowest-value mode (its purpose — locking block edits on shared custom maps — barely applies to a single-player game) but nearly free once the predicate gates exist. See the branch & commit plan below.

## Branch & commit plan

Branch `feat/game-modes` off `main`. Focused slices, each with `bun run lint` green (bisectable), Conventional Commit subjects, a body explaining the why, and **no `Co-Authored-By` trailer**. Tests ride with each feature slice; docs land in the same branch so it reviews as one PR.

1. `feat(modes): add GameMode plumbing & save v8` — `gameModes.ts` (enum, validator, presets, predicates), `WorldMeta.gameMode`, `SaveData` v8 + `migrateSaveV7toV8`, engine option/serialize, `GameState.gameMode`+`isFlying`, snapshot. Defaults to `survival` everywhere → **no behavior change yet**. Migration + predicate tests.
2. `feat(modes): creative mode` — no-damage/hunger/death + free-build (instant, no drop/consume) gates; flight + `toggleFlight`; `FLY_SPEED` config. Tests.
3. `feat(modes): creative inventory palette` — all-items tab in `InventoryPanel`. Tests.
4. `feat(modes): spectator mode` — noclip, invulnerable, interaction-blocked, mobs ignore, translucent player, HUD/hotbar hidden. Tests.
5. `feat(modes): adventure mode` — wire `canEditBlocks` (break + place disabled, survival otherwise). Tests.
6. `feat(modes): switch mode in pause menu & pick at creation` — `setGameMode` + state reset, pause selector, `CreateWorldForm` grid, world-card badge. Tests.
7. `docs(modes): document game modes` — manual, reference, save-format, tuning, README, CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]`.

Full verify gate runs before the branch is PR-ready. **Pushing and opening the PR are user-authorized** — I won't push or run `gh pr create --repo hutusi/monecraft --base main` until you ask.

## Mode behavior matrix

| Behavior | Survival | Creative | Adventure | Spectator |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Damage / hunger / death | ✓ | ✕ | ✓ | ✕ |
| Break blocks | ✓ | instant, no drop/durability | ✕ | ✕ |
| Place blocks | ✓ (consumes) | ✓ (no consume) | ✕ | ✕ |
| Flight | ✕ | ✓ | ✕ | ✓ noclip |
| Terrain collision | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✕ |
| Interact (door/chest/trade/attack/eat/fish) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✕ |
| Mobs threaten player | ✓ | ✕ | ✓ | ✕ |
| Inventory | normal | all-items palette | normal | hidden |
| Player render | solid | solid | solid | translucent |

## Mode predicates (the core abstraction)

New `lib/game/gameModes.ts` — `GameMode = "survival" | "creative" | "adventure" | "spectator"`, an `isGameMode` validator, and `GAME_MODE_PRESETS` (`{ id, label, blurb }`, parallel to `WORLD_TYPE_PRESETS` in `lib/game/worlds.ts`). Plus intent predicates each system gates on (so no scattered string compares):

- `takesDamage(mode)` = survival | adventure
- `canEditBlocks(mode)` = survival | creative (adventure & spectator: false)
- `freeBuild(mode)` = creative (instant break, no drop, no consume)
- `canInteract(mode)` = mode !== spectator
- `canFly(mode)` = creative | spectator
- `isNoclip(mode)` = spectator
- `usesInventory(mode)` = mode !== spectator
- `mobsThreaten(mode)` = survival | adventure

## Data model & plumbing (copy the `worldType` pattern)

`worldType` is the proven per-world-enum template (validator → `WorldMeta` → `SaveData` additive + migration → `GameEngine` boot → `CreateWorldForm`). Mirror it for `gameMode`:

1. **`WorldMeta`** (`lib/game/worlds.ts`): add `gameMode` (creation-time value for first boot + world-card badge); extend `sanitizeWorld` (unknown → `survival`) and `createWorld` deps.
2. **`SaveData` v8** (`lib/game/types.ts`): `SaveDataV8 = Omit<SaveDataV7,"version"> & { version: 8; gameMode?: GameMode }` — the authoritative *current* value (may have been switched in-game).
3. **Migration** (`lib/game/save.ts`): `migrateSaveV7toV8` pure bump; extend the `readSave` chain; repoint `SaveData` to v8.
4. **`GameEngine`** (`GameEngine.ts`): add `gameMode` to `GameEngineOptions`; resolve `save ?? options ?? "survival"` (save wins on restore, like `worldType`); `serialize()` writes it.
5. **`GameState`** (`engine/state.ts`): add `gameMode` and transient `isFlying`; expose both on the React snapshot for HUD/menus.

## Creative — gate via predicates

- **No damage / hunger / death** — `playerStats.ts` (`tickHungerDrain` skip; `tickHealthRegen` force full; gate `applyDamage` in water/lava/oxygen ticks), `playerMotion.ts` (fall + void damage), `playerLife.ts` (`applyDamageWithArmor`/`applyUnmitigatedDamage` early-return) — all gated on `!takesDamage(mode)`.
- **Free build** — `mining.ts` `tickMining`: when `freeBuild`, break instantly, skip `addBlockDrop` + `consumeToolDurability`; `placeSelectedBlock`: skip the `adjustSlotCount(-1)` decrement.
- **Flight** — `playerMotion.ts`: when `isFlying`, replace gravity with vertical control (Space ascend / crouch descend / hover) at `FLY_SPEED`. `inputController.ts`: double-tap Space → `toggleFlight` when `canFly`.
- **All-items palette** — new tab in `components/game/InventoryPanel.tsx` listing `ITEM_DEFS` grouped by `kind` (reuse `inv-grid` buttons + `createSlot`/`adjustSlotCount`), with a search box; shown when `gameMode === "creative"`.

## Spectator — noclip free-cam

- **Always flying, noclip** — `playerMotion.ts`: when `isNoclip`, skip the terrain collision-resolution/depenetration step and integrate position straight from velocity; force `isFlying` true, never grounded; reuse the Creative fly controls.
- **Invulnerable / no hunger / no death** — same `!takesDamage` gates as Creative.
- **No interaction at all** — gate world-affecting commands in `GameEngine.dispatch` and `tickMining` behind `canInteract`: mining, placing, attack, use/eat/fish/trade/interact all no-op; only movement, camera, pause, and the mode menu remain.
- **Mobs ignore the player** — `mobAI.ts`/`projectileAI.ts`/`spawnDirector.ts` gate aggro + player-damage on `mobsThreaten(mode)` (false for Creative & Spectator).
- **Translucent player** — renderer: when spectator, draw the player model semi-transparent (or hidden in third-person); first-person unchanged. Hide the hotbar/HUD bars.

## Adventure — survival minus terrain editing

Identical to Survival (damage, hunger, mobs, combat, doors/chests/trade/eat/fish all work) **except block break + place are disabled** — covered by the `canEditBlocks` gate already added to `tickMining` (break) and `placeSelectedBlock`. No flight, normal HUD. Essentially free once the predicate gates exist.

## In-game switching + state reset

- Pause menu gains a **Game Mode** selector (4 options) using `GAME_MODE_PRESETS`.
- New `setGameMode` engine command. On switch, reset transient state so nothing leaks:
  - Entering a no-damage mode (Creative/Spectator): hearts/hunger forced full; reset lava/void/water/drown timers in `state.timers`.
  - Entering Spectator: `isFlying = true`, noclip on. Leaving Spectator: snap out of any solid block (reuse the existing auto-unstuck depenetration), `isFlying = false`.
  - Entering Survival/Adventure: `isFlying = false` (gravity resumes); restore full hearts/hunger.

## UI surfaces

- `components/menu/CreateWorldForm.tsx`: a 4-option game-mode grid mirroring the existing `world-type-grid` markup; thread through `WorldSelect.onCreate` → `createWorld({ gameMode })`.
- `components/menu/WorldSelect.tsx`: a world-card mode badge (like the current `worldType` sub-label).
- HUD (`components/game/*`): hide hearts + hunger in Creative/Spectator; hide the hotbar in Spectator; small "Creative"/"Spectator"/flying indicator.
- Pause menu: the mode selector.

## Config tunables (`lib/game/config.ts`)

`FLY_SPEED` (≈12–16) and `FLY_DOUBLE_TAP_WINDOW_SECONDS` (0.3), under a new "Game modes / flight" group.

## Representative files

New: `lib/game/gameModes.ts`, `components/game/CreativeInventoryTab.tsx` (or inline).
Edited: `lib/game/types.ts`, `save.ts`, `worlds.ts`, `engine/state.ts`, `engine/GameEngine.ts`, `useMinecraftGame.ts`, `config.ts`, `input/inputController.ts`; systems `playerMotion.ts` / `playerStats.ts` / `playerLife.ts` / `mining.ts` / `spawnDirector.ts` / `mobAI.ts` / `projectileAI.ts`; the player renderer; components `CreateWorldForm.tsx` / `WorldSelect.tsx` / `InventoryPanel.tsx` / pause menu / HUD.

## Tests (colocated `*.test.ts`)

- Migration `v7 → v8` (old save loads as `survival`).
- Predicates table (each mode's flags).
- Creative: no damage, instant break, no drop/durability, no consume on place; palette inserts.
- Spectator: noclip (moves through a solid block), invulnerable, all interaction commands no-op, mobs don't aggro.
- Adventure: damage still applies; break + place blocked; combat/interaction still work.
- Flight: `toggleFlight` only when `canFly`; ascend/descend change `velocity.y`.
- Switch resets timers + hearts/hunger + noclip exit. Update `config.test.ts` integrity (exhaustive presets, `ITEM_DEFS` palette coverage).

## Docs (ship with the change — part of the gate)

`docs/manual.md` (new "Game Modes" section: the four modes, flight, palette, switching), `docs/reference.md` (modes table), `docs/save-format.md` (v8 field + migration), `docs/tuning.md` (`FLY_SPEED` + double-tap), `README.md` (fly controls), `CHANGELOG.md` (`[Unreleased]`).

## Verification

- Gate: `bun run lint`, `typecheck`, `format:check`, `bun test`, `bun run build` green; `bun run test:e2e` (touches input + shell).
- Manual pass (input/visual change): **Creative** — fly (double-tap Space), build from palette with no item loss, take no damage, hearts/hunger hidden. **Spectator** — fly through terrain, can't break/interact, mobs ignore you, player translucent. **Adventure** — take damage and fight mobs, but can't break/place blocks. **Switching** — flip modes in the pause menu and confirm clean state resets (flight off, HUD restored, no queued damage).

## Next time (deferred)

- **Difficulty axis** (`Normal ⇄ Peaceful`) — switchable; Peaceful gates hostile spawns. The `mobsThreaten`/spawn gates added here are the hook it plugs into.
- **Hardcore** world flag — one life; death deletes the world (touches respawn + the menu-shell `deleteWorld` flow).
- Other candidates still open: companions & taming, advancements & goals, building & decoration, water & exploration.

1	/**
2	 * World types — generation presets the player picks at world creation. Each is
3	 * a terrain-config variant over the same biome map; `"default"` is the original
4	 * generator (byte-identical to before this feature). The chosen type is part of
5	 * the save contract for non-default worlds: the engine must regenerate with the
6	 * same type the block-diffs were recorded against.
7	 *
8	 * This module is intentionally free of the generation `GEN` constants so the
9	 * game/UI layer can import the type without pulling in the worldgen module; the
10	 * actual per-type terrain config lives in `terrainConfigFor` (generation.ts).
11	 */
12	export type WorldType = "default" | "flat" | "amplified" | "islands";
13	
14	export const WORLD_TYPE_IDS: readonly WorldType[] = ["default", "flat", "amplified", "islands"];
15	
16	/** Coerces a stored/UI value to a WorldType; unknown values are not world types. */
17	export function isWorldType(value: unknown): value is WorldType {
18	  return typeof value === "string" && (WORLD_TYPE_IDS as readonly string[]).includes(value);
19	}
20

6	 * in one versioned manifest blob; the heavy per-world saves stay separate so

8	 *
9	 * A world's `seed` is resolved once at creation and is the source of truth for
10	 * regeneration; `worldgenVersion` records the WORLDGEN_VERSION it was generated
11	 * under so a future baseline bump can discard its stale block-diffs.
12	 */
13	
14	import { isWorldType, type WorldType } from "@/lib/world";
15	import { WORLDGEN_VERSION } from "./config";
16	import { readManifestRaw, resolveDeps, sanitizeName, writeManifest, type ManifestDeps } from "./manifest";
17	import { getProfile } from "./profiles";
18	
19	export type WorldMeta = {
20	  id: string;
21	  profileId: string;
22	  name: string;
23	  seed: number;
24	  worldType: WorldType;
25	  worldgenVersion: number;
26	  createdAt: number;
27	  lastPlayedAt: number;
28	};
29	
30	/** UI metadata for the world-type picker (the engine side lives in lib/world/worldTypes.ts). */
31	export const WORLD_TYPE_PRESETS: ReadonlyArray<{ id: WorldType; label: string; blurb: string }> = [
32	  { id: "default", label: "Default", blurb: "Balanced terrain, every biome" },
33	  { id: "flat", label: "Superflat", blurb: "Level ground — a builder's canvas" },
34	  { id: "amplified", label: "Amplified", blurb: "Towering, dramatic relief" },
35	  { id: "islands", label: "Islands", blurb: "Scattered land in a wide sea" }
36	];
37	
38	export type WorldsManifest = {
39	  version: 1;
40	  worlds: WorldMeta[];
41	};
42	
43	export const WORLDS_KEY = "minecraft_worlds_v1";
44	export const WORLD_SAVE_PREFIX = "minecraft_world_save_";
45	export const MAX_WORLD_NAME = 32;
46	export const DEFAULT_WORLD_NAME = "New World";
47	export const MAX_SEED = 2147483647;
48	
49	export const DEFAULT_WORLDS_MANIFEST: WorldsManifest = { version: 1, worlds: [] };
50	
51	/** The per-world SaveData key handed to readSave/writeSave. */
52	export function worldSaveKey(worldId: string): string {
53	  return WORLD_SAVE_PREFIX + worldId;
54	}
55	
56	/** FNV-1a hash of a text seed into a stable non-negative 31-bit integer (Minecraft-style). */
57	export function hashStringToSeed(text: string): number {
58	  let hash = 0x811c9dc5;
59	  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i += 1) {
60	    hash ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
61	    hash = Math.imul(hash, 0x01000193);
62	  }
63	  return Math.abs(hash | 0) % MAX_SEED;
64	}
65	
66	/**
67	 * Resolves a user seed input to an integer in 0..MAX_SEED-1: blank → random
68	 * (same entropy the engine used for a fresh world), numeric text → clamped int,
69	 * any other text → stable hash. `rng` is injectable for deterministic tests.
70	 */
71	export function resolveSeed(seedInput: string | null, rng: () => number = Math.random): number {
72	  const trimmed = (seedInput ?? "").trim();
73	  if (trimmed === "") return Math.floor(rng() * MAX_SEED);
74	  const asNumber = Number(trimmed);
75	  if (Number.isFinite(asNumber)) return Math.floor(Math.abs(asNumber)) % MAX_SEED;
76	  return hashStringToSeed(trimmed);
77	}
78	
79	/** Coerces one raw entry into a valid WorldMeta, or null if it can't be salvaged. */
80	function sanitizeWorld(raw: unknown): WorldMeta | null {
81	  if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object") return null;
82	  const entry = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
83	  if (typeof entry.id !== "string" || entry.id.length === 0) return null;
84	  if (typeof entry.profileId !== "string" || entry.profileId.length === 0) return null;
85	  if (typeof entry.seed !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(entry.seed)) return null;
86	  const num = (value: unknown, fallback: number) => (typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback);
87	  return {
88	    id: entry.id,
89	    profileId: entry.profileId,
90	    name: sanitizeName(entry.name, DEFAULT_WORLD_NAME, MAX_WORLD_NAME),
91	    seed: Math.floor(entry.seed),
92	    worldType: isWorldType(entry.worldType) ? entry.worldType : "default",
93	    worldgenVersion: num(entry.worldgenVersion, WORLDGEN_VERSION),
94	    createdAt: num(entry.createdAt, 0),
95	    lastPlayedAt: num(entry.lastPlayedAt, 0)
96	  };
97	}
98	
99	/** Reads the worlds manifest, dropping malformed entries. Never throws. */
100	export function readWorlds(storage: Storage = localStorage): WorldsManifest {
101	  const raw = readManifestRaw(WORLDS_KEY, storage) as Partial<WorldsManifest> | null;
102	  // Only the current manifest version is understood; an unknown version falls
103	  // back to the default rather than risk misreading an incompatible payload.
104	  if (!raw || raw.version !== 1 || !Array.isArray(raw.worlds)) return { ...DEFAULT_WORLDS_MANIFEST };
105	  return { version: 1, worlds: raw.worlds.map(sanitizeWorld).filter((w): w is WorldMeta => w !== null) };
106	}
107	
108	export function getWorld(id: string, storage: Storage = localStorage): WorldMeta | null {
109	  return readWorlds(storage).worlds.find((w) => w.id === id) ?? null;
110	}
111	
112	/** A profile's worlds, most-recently-played first (ties broken by creation time). */
113	export function worldsForProfile(profileId: string, storage: Storage = localStorage): WorldMeta[] {
114	  return readWorlds(storage)
115	    .worlds.filter((w) => w.profileId === profileId)
116	    .sort((a, b) => b.lastPlayedAt - a.lastPlayedAt || b.createdAt - a.createdAt);
117	}
118	
119	/** Creates a world for an existing profile, persists it, and returns it (throws on an unknown profile). `deps.rng` seeds blank-input worlds; `deps.worldType` picks the generation preset. */
120	export function createWorld(
121	  profileId: string,
122	  name: string,
123	  seedInput: string | null,
124	  deps: ManifestDeps & { rng?: () => number; worldType?: WorldType } = {}
125	): WorldMeta {
126	  const { storage, now, uid } = resolveDeps(deps);
127	  // Worlds must belong to a real profile — refuse to persist an orphan record.
128	  if (!getProfile(profileId, storage)) throw new Error(`createWorld: unknown profile "${profileId}"`);
129	  const createdAt = now();
130	  const world: WorldMeta = {
131	    id: uid(),
132	    profileId,
133	    name: sanitizeName(name, DEFAULT_WORLD_NAME, MAX_WORLD_NAME),
134	    seed: resolveSeed(seedInput, deps.rng ?? Math.random),
135	    worldType: isWorldType(deps.worldType) ? deps.worldType : "default",
136	    worldgenVersion: WORLDGEN_VERSION,
137	    createdAt,
138	    lastPlayedAt: createdAt
139	  };
140	  const manifest = readWorlds(storage);
141	  writeManifest(WORLDS_KEY, { version: 1, worlds: [...manifest.worlds, world] }, storage);
142	  return world;
143	}
144	
145	export function renameWorld(id: string, name: string, storage: Storage = localStorage): WorldsManifest {
146	  const manifest = readWorlds(storage);
147	  const next: WorldsManifest = {
148	    version: 1,
149	    worlds: manifest.worlds.map((w) => (w.id === id ? { ...w, name: sanitizeName(name, w.name, MAX_WORLD_NAME) } : w))
150	  };
151	  writeManifest(WORLDS_KEY, next, storage);
152	  return next;
153	}
154	
155	/** Bumps a world's `lastPlayedAt` so it sorts to the top of its profile's list. */
156	export function touchWorld(id: string, deps: ManifestDeps = {}): WorldsManifest {
157	  const { storage, now } = resolveDeps(deps);
158	  const manifest = readWorlds(storage);
159	  const next: WorldsManifest = {
160	    version: 1,
161	    worlds: manifest.worlds.map((w) => (w.id === id ? { ...w, lastPlayedAt: now() } : w))
162	  };
163	  writeManifest(WORLDS_KEY, next, storage);
164	  return next;
165	}
166	
167	/** Removes a world from the index and deletes its save blob. */
168	export function deleteWorld(id: string, storage: Storage = localStorage): WorldsManifest {
169	  const manifest = readWorlds(storage);
170	  const next: WorldsManifest = { version: 1, worlds: manifest.worlds.filter((w) => w.id !== id) };
171	  writeManifest(WORLDS_KEY, next, storage);
172	  try {
173	    storage.removeItem(worldSaveKey(id));
174	  } catch {
175	    // A failed blob cleanup just leaves an orphaned key; the index no longer references it.
176	  }
177	  return next;
178	}
179	
180	/** Cascade for profile deletion: removes every world of a profile and its save blobs. */
181	export function deleteWorldsForProfile(profileId: string, storage: Storage = localStorage): WorldsManifest {
182	  const manifest = readWorlds(storage);
183	  const doomed = manifest.worlds.filter((w) => w.profileId === profileId);
184	  const next: WorldsManifest = { version: 1, worlds: manifest.worlds.filter((w) => w.profileId !== profileId) };
185	  writeManifest(WORLDS_KEY, next, storage);
186	  for (const world of doomed) {
187	    try {
188	      storage.removeItem(worldSaveKey(world.id));
189	    } catch {
190	      // Orphaned blob; the index no longer references it.
191	    }
192	  }
193	  return next;
194	}
195

27	function normalizeSelectedSlot(value: number): number {
28	  const index = Number.isFinite(value) ? Math.floor(value) : 0;
29	  return Math.max(0, Math.min(HOTBAR_SLOTS - 1, index));
30	}

32	export function migrateSaveV1toV2(save: SaveDataV1): SaveDataV2 {
33	  const migrated: SaveDataV2 = { ...save, version: 2, selectedSlot: normalizeSelectedSlot(save.selectedSlot) };
34	
35	  if (Array.isArray(save.inventorySlots)) {
36	    const packed: Array<{ id: string | null; count: number; durability?: number }> = [];
37	    for (const saved of save.inventorySlots) {
38	      if (!saved?.id || saved.count <= 0) continue;
39	      // Items without durability stack; merge them into an earlier stack first.
40	      const stackable = ITEM_DEF_BY_ID[saved.id] ? !ITEM_DEF_BY_ID[saved.id].maxDurability : false;
41	      let remaining = saved.count;
42	      if (stackable) {
43	        for (const slot of packed) {
44	          if (slot.id !== saved.id || slot.count >= MAX_STACK_SIZE) continue;
45	          const moved = Math.min(MAX_STACK_SIZE - slot.count, remaining);
46	          slot.count += moved;
47	          remaining -= moved;
48	          if (remaining === 0) break;
49	        }
50	      }
51	      while (remaining > 0 && packed.length < INVENTORY_SLOTS) {
52	        const moved = Math.min(maxStackSizeForItem(saved.id), remaining);

143	/** Validates persisted enchantments: known ids and integer levels clamped to 1..max; undefined when none survive. */

159	 * anything invalid. Shared by inventory and container restore.
160	 */
161	function restoreSlot(saved: SavedSlot | undefined): InventorySlot {
162	  if (!saved?.id || saved.count <= 0 || !ITEM_DEF_BY_ID[saved.id]) return createEmptySlot();
163	  const slot = createSlot(saved.id, Math.min(maxStackSizeForItem(saved.id), Math.max(0, Math.floor(saved.count))));
164	  if ((slot.kind === "tool" || slot.kind === "weapon" || slot.kind === "armor") && slot.maxDurability) {
165	    if (typeof saved.durability === "number") {
166	      const loaded = Math.floor(saved.durability);
167	      if (loaded <= 0) return createEmptySlot();
168	      slot.durability = Math.max(1, Math.min(slot.maxDurability, loaded));
169	    } else {
170	      slot.durability = slot.maxDurability;
171	    }
172	    // Enchantments live only on durable gear; validated against the known set.
173	    const enchantments = restoreEnchantments(saved.enchantments);
174	    if (enchantments) slot.enchantments = enchantments;
175	  }
176	  return slot;
177	}
178	
179	/** Snapshots non-empty chest containers for persistence (empty chests carry no data). */
180	export function serializeContainers(containers: Map<number, InventorySlot[]>): SavedContainer[] {
181	  const out: SavedContainer[] = [];
182	  for (const [index, slots] of containers) {
183	    if (!slots.some((slot) => slot.id && slot.count > 0)) continue;
184	    out.push({ index, slots: inventorySlotsSnapshot(slots) });
185	  }
186	  return out;
187	}
188	
189	/** Snapshots the set of opened/broken dungeon chest voxel indices for persistence. */
190	export function serializeLootedChests(looted: Set<number>): number[] {
191	  return [...looted];
192	}
193	
194	/** Reads the opened/broken dungeon chest indices from a save (finite numbers only). */
195	export function readLootedChests(save: SaveData): number[] {
196	  if (!Array.isArray(save.lootedChests)) return [];
197	  return save.lootedChests.filter((value) => Number.isFinite(value));
198	}
199	
200	// Every known status-effect id, as a Record keyed by EffectId so adding an
201	// effect without listing it here is a compile error (keeps the reader total).
202	const VALID_EFFECT_IDS: Record<EffectId, true> = {
203	  speed: true,
204	  strength: true,
205	  regeneration: true,
206	  fire_resistance: true,
207	  water_breathing: true,
208	  poison: true
209	};
210	
211	/** Snapshots the active status effects (id + remaining seconds) for persistence. */
212	export function serializeEffects(effects: Map<EffectId, number>): SavedEffect[] {
213	  const out: SavedEffect[] = [];
214	  for (const [id, remaining] of effects) {
215	    if (remaining > 0) out.push({ id, remaining });
216	  }
217	  return out;
218	}
219	
220	/** Reads active effects from a save, dropping unknown ids and non-positive/garbage durations. */
221	export function restoreEffects(save: SaveData): SavedEffect[] {
222	  if (!Array.isArray(save.effects)) return [];
223	  const out: SavedEffect[] = [];
224	  for (const entry of save.effects) {
225	    if (!entry || typeof entry.id !== "string" || !Object.hasOwn(VALID_EFFECT_IDS, entry.id)) continue;
226	    if (!Number.isFinite(entry.remaining) || entry.remaining <= 0) continue;
227	    out.push({ id: entry.id, remaining: entry.remaining });
228	  }
229	  return out;
230	}
231	
232	/**
233	 * Reads chest containers from a save into validated, CHEST_SLOTS-length slot
234	 * arrays keyed by voxel index. Per-slot validation only — the engine still
235	 * confirms each index actually holds a Chest block before using it.
236	 */
237	export function readContainers(save: SaveData): Array<{ index: number; slots: InventorySlot[] }> {
238	  if (!Array.isArray(save.blockEntities)) return [];
239	  const out: Array<{ index: number; slots: InventorySlot[] }> = [];
240	  for (const entry of save.blockEntities) {
241	    if (!entry || !Number.isFinite(entry.index) || !Array.isArray(entry.slots)) continue;
242	    const slots = Array.from({ length: CHEST_SLOTS }, (_, i) => restoreSlot(entry.slots[i]));
243	    out.push({ index: entry.index, slots });
244	  }
245	  return out;
246	}
247	
248	/**
249	 * Rebuilds inventory slots from a save, dropping unknown items, clamping
250	 * counts and durability, and skipping broken gear. Supports both the current
251	 * inventorySlots shape and the legacy inventoryCounts shape. Returns null when
252	 * the save carries no inventory.
253	 */
254	export function restoreInventorySlots(save: SaveData): InventorySlot[] | null {
255	  if (Array.isArray(save.inventorySlots)) {
256	    const slots = Array.from({ length: INVENTORY_SLOTS }, () => createEmptySlot());
257	    for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(INVENTORY_SLOTS, save.inventorySlots.length); i += 1) {
258	      slots[i] = restoreSlot(save.inventorySlots[i]);
259	    }
260	    return slots;
261	  }
262	
263	  if (save.inventoryCounts) {
264	    const slots = Array.from({ length: INVENTORY_SLOTS }, () => createEmptySlot());
265	    let cursor = 0;
266	    for (const [id, raw] of Object.entries(save.inventoryCounts)) {
267	      if (!ITEM_DEF_BY_ID[id]) continue;
268	      let remaining = Math.max(0, Math.floor(raw));
269	      while (remaining > 0 && cursor < slots.length) {
270	        const add = Math.min(maxStackSizeForItem(id), remaining);
271	        slots[cursor] = createSlot(id, add);
272	        cursor += 1;
273	        remaining -= add;
274	      }
275	    }
276	    return slots;
277	  }
278	
279	  return null;
280	}
281	
282	/** Restores equipped armor from a save, ignoring ids that are not valid armor for the slot. */
283	export function restoreEquippedArmor(save: SaveData): EquippedArmor | null {
284	  if (!save.equippedArmor) return null;
285	  const next = createEmptyArmorEquipment();
286	  for (const armorSlot of ARMOR_SLOTS) {
287	    const equippedId = save.equippedArmor[armorSlot];
288	    if (!equippedId) continue;
289	    const def = ITEM_DEF_BY_ID[equippedId];
290	    if (def?.kind !== "armor" || def.armorSlot !== armorSlot) continue;
291	    next[armorSlot] = equippedId;
292	  }
293	  return next;
294	}
295	
296	export function restoreSelectedSlot(save: SaveData): number | null {
297	  if (typeof save.selectedSlot !== "number") return null;
298	  return normalizeSelectedSlot(save.selectedSlot);
299	}
300	
301	/** Restores the day clock from a save (finite, non-negative); null if absent/invalid. */
302	export function restoreDayClock(save: SaveData): number | null {
303	  if (typeof save.dayClock !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(save.dayClock) || save.dayClock < 0) return null;
304	  return save.dayClock;
305	}
306	
307	/** Restores hearts clamped to 1..MAX_HEARTS; null if absent/invalid. */
308	export function restoreHearts(save: SaveData): number | null {
309	  if (typeof save.hearts !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(save.hearts)) return null;
310	  return Math.max(1, Math.min(MAX_HEARTS, Math.floor(save.hearts)));
311	}
312	
313	/** Restores hunger clamped to 0..MAX_HUNGER; null if absent/invalid. */
314	export function restoreHungerLevel(save: SaveData): number | null {
315	  if (typeof save.hunger !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(save.hunger)) return null;
316	  return Math.max(0, Math.min(MAX_HUNGER, Math.floor(save.hunger)));
317	}
318	
319	/** Restores banked XP (finite, ≥ 0); 0 when absent or invalid. */
320	export function restoreXp(save: SaveData): number {
321	  if (typeof save.xp !== "number" || !Number.isFinite(save.xp) || save.xp < 0) return 0;
322	  return Math.floor(save.xp);
323	}
324	
325	/** Restores the bed respawn point; null if absent or explicitly cleared. */
326	export function restoreSpawnPoint(save: SaveData): { x: number; y: number; z: number } | null {
327	  const sp = save.spawnPoint;
328	  if (!sp || !Number.isFinite(sp.x) || !Number.isFinite(sp.y) || !Number.isFinite(sp.z)) return null;
329	  return { x: Math.floor(sp.x), y: Math.floor(sp.y), z: Math.floor(sp.z) };
330	}
331	
332	/**
333	 * Restores the player's position; null when absent or non-finite. A corrupt save
334	 * with NaN/Infinity coords would otherwise load a broken world — and slip past the
335	 * `position.y < 2` unstuck net, since any comparison with NaN is false. Coords stay
336	 * floats (the player isn't grid-aligned), unlike the floored spawn point.
337	 */
338	export function restorePlayerPosition(save: SaveData): { x: number; y: number; z: number } | null {
339	  const p = save.player;
340	  if (!p || !Number.isFinite(p.x) || !Number.isFinite(p.y) || !Number.isFinite(p.z)) return null;
341	  return { x: p.x, y: p.y, z: p.z };
342	}

215	        this.state.daylight = daylightAt(savedClock);
216	        this.state.daylightPercent = Math.round(this.state.daylight * 100);
217	      }
218	      const pos = restorePlayerPosition(save);
219	      if (pos) this.state.player.position.set(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z);
220	    }
221	
222	    // Safety check: if stuck after load, relocate to a plain.
223	    if (collidesAt(world, this.state.player.position, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT) || this.state.player.position.y < 2) {
224	      this.forceUnstuck();
225	    }
226	
227	    spawnInitialMobs(this.state, this.rng, this.surfaceYAt);
228	    // Seed weather from the (possibly restored) dayClock + player position so a
229	    // loaded save's first frame/snapshot is consistent before the first step().
230	    tickWeather(this.state);
231	    this.snapshot = this.buildSnapshot();
232	  }
233	
234	  /** Advances the simulation by dt seconds. The renderer draws the state afterwards. */
235	  step(dt: number, input: FrameInput): void {
236	    const state = this.state;
237	    if (state.paused) {
238	      // Full freeze: mobs, the day clock, mining, and stats all stop.
239	      this.refreshSnapshot();
240	      return;
241	    }
242	    state.capsActive = input.capsActive;
243	
244	    // Stuck detection / auto-unstuck.
245	    const inBadState = collidesAt(state.world, state.player.position, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT) || state.player.position.y < 2;
246	    state.timers.stuckTimer = inBadState ? state.timers.stuckTimer + dt : 0;
247	    if (state.timers.stuckTimer > STUCK_RESET_SECONDS) {
248	      this.forceUnstuck();
249	      state.timers.stuckTimer = 0;
250	    }
251	
252	    // Death: only mobs and the respawn countdown tick while dead.
253	    if (state.isDead) {
254	      if (tickRespawnTimer(state, dt)) this.respawn();
255	      else {
256	        tickMobs(state, dt, this.mobTickDeps);
257	        // Keep ticking so lit fuses and in-flight arrows resolve instead of
258	        // freezing for the respawn countdown; applyDamage no-ops while dead.
259	        tickPrimedTnt(state, dt, this.mobTickDeps);
260	        tickProjectiles(state, dt, this.mobTickDeps);
261	      }
262	      this.refreshSnapshot();
263	      return;
264	    }
265	
266	    // Sleeping: a full freeze during the fade, then a jump to the next morning.
267	    if (state.sleepTimer > 0) {
268	      state.sleepTimer = Math.max(0, state.sleepTimer - dt);
269	      if (state.sleepTimer === 0) this.wakeToMorning();
270	      this.refreshSnapshot();
271	      return;
272	    }
273	
274	    const move = tickPlayerMotion(state, input, dt, this.applyDamage);
275	    if (move.didJump) this.emit({ type: "jumped" });
276	    if (move.didLand) this.emit({ type: "landed", impact: move.landImpact });
277	    tickHungerDrain(state, move);
278	    tickHealthRegen(state, dt);
279	    // Status effects tick here so the fire-resist / water-breathing gates below are current.
280	    tickStatusEffects(state, dt, { applyPoisonDamage: this.applyPoisonDamage, emit: this.emit });
281	    tickWaterExposure(state, dt, this.applyEnvironmentalDamage);
282	    tickLavaExposure(state, dt, this.applyEnvironmentalDamage, hasEffect(state, "fire_resistance"));
283	    tickOxygen(state, dt, this.applyEnvironmentalDamage, hasEffect(state, "water_breathing"));
284	    state.timers.bowCooldownTimer = Math.max(0, state.timers.bowCooldownTimer - dt);
285	    tickMining(state, input, dt, this.emit, this.rng);
286	    tickThrownSpears(state, dt, this.removeMobAt, this.emit);
287	    tickFishing(state, dt, this.rng, this.emit);
288	    tickDayNight(state, dt);
289	    tickWeather(state);
290	    tickRandomBlocks(state, dt, this.rng);
291	    tickHostileSpawnDirector(state, dt, this.rng, this.surfaceYAt);
292	    tickSpawnerDirector(state, dt, this.rng, this.emit);
293	    tickMobs(state, dt, this.mobTickDeps);
294	    tickPrimedTnt(state, dt, this.mobTickDeps);
295	    tickProjectiles(state, dt, this.mobTickDeps);
296	    tickBreeding(state, dt, this.rng, this.surfaceYAt, this.emit);
297	    this.tickDebugInfo(dt);
298	
299	    this.refreshSnapshot();
300	  }
301	
302	  /** Applies a discrete player intent. */
303	  dispatch(command: Command): void {
304	    const state = this.state;
305	    switch (command.type) {
306	      case "selectSlot": {
307	        if (command.index >= 0 && command.index < Math.min(HOTBAR_SLOTS, state.inventory.length)) {
308	          state.selectedSlot = command.index;
309	        }
310	        break;
311	      }
312	      case "toggleInventory": {
313	        state.inventoryOpen = !state.inventoryOpen;
314	        if (!state.inventoryOpen) {
315	          state.craftingStation = null; // leaving the panel closes the station
316	          state.openContainerIndex = null; // ...and the open chest
317	        }
318	        break;
319	      }
320	      case "craft": {
321	        const recipe = RECIPES.find((entry) => entry.id === command.recipeId);
322	        if (!recipe || state.isDead) break;
323	        // Station recipes (e.g. furnace smelting) require that station to be open.
324	        // The UI gates these too, but dispatch is the spoofable surface to guard.
325	        if (recipe.station && recipe.station !== state.craftingStation) break;
326	        const next = inv.craft(state.inventory, recipe);
327	        if (!next) break;
328	        state.inventory = next;
329	        if (recipe.station) this.emit({ type: "smelted" });
330	        break;
331	      }
332	      case "swapSlots": {
333	        state.inventory = inv.swapSlots(state.inventory, command.from, command.to) ?? state.inventory;
334	        break;
335	      }
336	      case "moveStack": {
337	        this.applyMoveStack(command.from, command.to);
338	        break;
339	      }
340	      case "toggleEquipArmor": {
341	        state.equippedArmor = inv.toggleEquipArmor(state.inventory, state.equippedArmor, command.index) ?? state.equippedArmor;
342	        break;
343	      }
344	      case "eatFood": {
345	        if (state.isDead || state.inventoryOpen || state.sleepTimer > 0) break;
346	        const slot = state.inventory[state.selectedSlot];
347	        if (!slot?.id || slot.kind !== "food" || !slot.hunger || slot.count <= 0) break;
348	        const next = inv.adjustSlotCount(state.inventory, slot.id, -1, state.selectedSlot);
349	        if (!next) break;
350	        state.inventory = next;
351	        state.hunger = restoreHunger(state.hunger, slot.hunger);
352	        // Rotten flesh sometimes poisons — a never-lethal nibble of risk on the
353	        // most desperate food. Uses the injected rng so the roll is deterministic.
354	        if (slot.id === "rotten_flesh" && this.rng() < ROTTEN_FLESH_POISON_CHANCE) {
355	          addEffect(state, "poison", POISON_DURATION);
356	        }
357	        this.emit({ type: "ateFood" });
358	        break;
359	      }
360	      case "drinkPotion": {
361	        if (state.isDead || state.inventoryOpen || state.sleepTimer > 0) break;
362	        const slot = state.inventory[state.selectedSlot];
363	        if (!slot?.id || !slot.effect || slot.count <= 0) break;
364	        const next = inv.adjustSlotCount(state.inventory, slot.id, -1, state.selectedSlot);
365	        if (!next) break;
366	        state.inventory = next;
367	        addEffect(state, slot.effect.id, slot.effect.durationSeconds);
368	        this.emit({ type: "drankPotion" });
369	        break;
370	      }
371	      case "enchant": {
372	        // Only at an open enchanting table; applies to the selected item instance.
373	        if (state.isDead || state.craftingStation !== "enchanting") break;
374	        const slot = state.inventory[state.selectedSlot];
375	        if (!canEnchant(slot, command.enchant)) break;
376	        if (!spendXpLevels(state, ENCHANT_COST_LEVELS)) break; // too few levels
377	        const next = [...state.inventory];
378	        next[state.selectedSlot] = applyEnchant(slot, command.enchant);
379	        state.inventory = next;
380	        this.emit({ type: "enchanted", enchant: command.enchant });
381	        break;
382	      }
383	      case "placeBlock": {
384	        if (state.isDead || state.inventoryOpen || state.sleepTimer > 0) break;
385	        // Spears consume the right-click/E action before all world interaction.
386	        if (tryThrowSelectedSpear(state, this.emit, this.rng)) break;
387	        // Right-click precedence: feed an aimed animal, then interact with the
388	        // aimed block (bed, furnace), then use the held item (hoe, seeds); only
389	        // place a block if none of those consumed the click.
390	        if (tryFeedAimedMob(state, this.emit)) break;
391	        if (tryTradeAimedVillager(state, this.emit)) break;
392	        if (tryInteractBlock(state, this.emit)) break;
393	        if (this.trySummonBoss()) break;
394	        if (tryFish(state, this.emit, this.rng)) break;
395	        if (tryUseHeldItem(state, this.emit, this.rng)) break;
396	        placeSelectedBlock(state, this.emit);
397	        break;
398	      }
399	      case "attack": {
400	        if (state.isDead || state.inventoryOpen || state.sleepTimer > 0) break;
401	        this.emit({ type: "attackSwung" });
402	        // A held bow fires arrows instead of meleeing; tryFireBow no-ops on
403	        // cooldown or with no arrows, but the swing animation still plays.
404	        if (isBow(state.inventory[state.selectedSlot])) {
405	          tryFireBow(state, this.emit, this.rng);
406	          break;
407	        }
408	        const heldWeapon = state.inventory[state.selectedSlot];
409	        const hitKind = tryAttackMob(state, weaponDamage(state) + strengthBonus(state) + sharpnessBonus(heldWeapon), this.removeMobAt, weaponReach(state));
410	        if (hitKind) {
411	          this.emit({ type: "mobHit", kind: hitKind });
412	          state.inventory = inv.consumeToolDurability(state.inventory, state.selectedSlot, 1, this.rng) ?? state.inventory;
413	          resetMining(state);
414	        }
415	        break;
416	      }
417	      case "unstuck": {
418	        if (state.isDead) break;
419	        this.forceUnstuck();
420	        break;
421	      }
422	      case "pause": {
423	        // The inventory panel, death screen, and victory screen own their
424	        // lock-loss; only plain gameplay lock-loss (or an explicit Escape) opens
425	        // the pause menu. Sleeping is a brief, atomic freeze — pausing mid-fade
426	        // would stall the sleep timer (step early-returns on paused before sleep).
427	        if (state.inventoryOpen || state.isDead || state.sleepTimer > 0 || state.victory) break;
428	        state.paused = true;
429	        state.craftingStation = null;
430	        state.openContainerIndex = null;
431	        break;
432	      }
433	      case "resume": {
434	        state.paused = false;
435	        break;
436	      }
437	      case "toggleDebug": {
438	        state.debugOpen = !state.debugOpen;
439	        state.debugInfo = state.debugOpen ? this.currentDebugInfo() : null;
440	        break;
441	      }
442	      case "toggleCameraView": {
443	        // Render-only, so it works even while dead or paused (like Minecraft F5).
444	        state.cameraMode = nextCameraMode(state.cameraMode);
445	        break;
446	      }
447	      case "respawn": {
448	        // Skip the rest of the countdown; the next step performs the respawn.
449	        if (state.isDead) state.respawnTimer = 0;
450	        break;
451	      }
452	      case "dismissVictory": {
453	        state.victory = false;
454	        break;
455	      }
456	    }
457	    this.syncEquippedArmor();
458	    this.refreshSnapshot();
459	  }
