461	  /** Mouse-look: applied directly by the input controller (radians). */
462	  applyLook(deltaYaw: number, deltaPitch: number): void {
463	    const player = this.state.player;
464	    player.yaw += deltaYaw;
465	    player.pitch = Math.max(-Math.PI / 2 + 0.01, Math.min(Math.PI / 2 - 0.01, player.pitch + deltaPitch));
466	  }
467	
468	  /** Current world + player state as a persistable save. */
469	  serialize(): SaveData {
470	    const state = this.state;
471	    return {
472	      version: 7,
473	      seed: state.world.seed,
474	      worldType: this.worldType,
475	      changes: state.blockChanges.changes(),
476	      inventorySlots: inventorySlotsSnapshot(state.inventory),
477	      equippedArmor: { ...state.equippedArmor },
478	      selectedSlot: state.selectedSlot,
479	      player: {
480	        x: state.player.position.x,
481	        y: state.player.position.y,
482	        z: state.player.position.z
483	      },
484	      dayClock: state.dayClock,
485	      hearts: state.hearts,
486	      hunger: state.hunger,
487	      spawnPoint: state.spawnPoint ? { ...state.spawnPoint } : null,
488	      blockEntities: serializeContainers(state.containers),
489	      lootedChests: serializeLootedChests(state.lootedDungeonChests),
490	      effects: serializeEffects(state.effects),
491	      xp: state.xp
492	    };
493	  }
494	
495	  subscribe = (listener: () => void): (() => void) => {
496	    this.listeners.add(listener);
497	    return () => this.listeners.delete(listener);
498	  };
499	
500	  getSnapshot = (): GameSnapshot => this.snapshot;
501	
502	  /** Drains queued one-shot gameplay events for the shell (death screen, audio). */
503	  consumeEvents(): GameEvent[] {
504	    if (this.events.length === 0) return this.events;
505	    const drained = this.events;
506	    this.events = [];
507	    return drained;
508	  }
509	
510	  private emit = (event: GameEvent): void => {
511	    this.events.push(event);
512	  };
513	
514	  /**
515	   * Moves a slot between the player inventory and the open chest. Indices at or
516	   * above CONTAINER_SLOT_BASE address the container; below it, the inventory.
517	   * Writes back whichever of the two arrays the move touched.
518	   */
519	  private applyMoveStack(from: number, to: number): void {
520	    const state = this.state;
521	    const container = state.openContainerIndex !== null ? state.containers.get(state.openContainerIndex) : undefined;
522	    const resolve = (index: number): { arr: InventorySlot[]; local: number } | null => {
523	      if (index >= CONTAINER_SLOT_BASE) return container ? { arr: container, local: index - CONTAINER_SLOT_BASE } : null;
524	      return { arr: state.inventory, local: index };
525	    };
526	    const a = resolve(from);
527	    const b = resolve(to);
528	    if (!a || !b) return;
529	    const moved = inv.moveStack(a.arr, a.local, b.arr, b.local);
530	    if (!moved) return;
531	
532	    // Resolve each side's destination BEFORE writing: the first write reassigns
533	    // state.inventory, which would make a later `arr === state.inventory` check
534	    // stale and misroute an inventory↔inventory move into the open chest.
535	    const aIsInventory = a.arr === state.inventory;
536	    const bIsInventory = b.arr === state.inventory;
537	    const writeBack = (isInventory: boolean, next: InventorySlot[]): void => {
538	      if (isInventory) state.inventory = next;
539	      else if (state.openContainerIndex !== null) state.containers.set(state.openContainerIndex, next);
540	    };
541	    writeBack(aIsInventory, moved.a);
542	    writeBack(bIsInventory, moved.b);
543	  }
544	
545	  private applyDamage = (amount: number): void => {
546	    const heartsBefore = this.state.hearts;
547	    const died = applyDamageWithArmor(this.state, amount, this.rng);
548	    this.syncEquippedArmor();
549	    if (died) {
550	      clearEffects(this.state);
551	      resetMining(this.state);
552	      this.emit({ type: "died" });
553	    } else if (this.state.hearts < heartsBefore) {
554	      this.emit({ type: "playerHurt" });
555	    }
556	  };
557	
558	  private applyEnvironmentalDamage = (amount: number): void => {
559	    const heartsBefore = this.state.hearts;
560	    const died = applyUnmitigatedDamage(this.state, amount);
561	    if (died) {
562	      clearEffects(this.state);
563	      resetMining(this.state);
564	      this.emit({ type: "died" });
565	    } else if (this.state.hearts < heartsBefore) {
566	      this.emit({ type: "playerHurt" });
567	    }
568	  };
569	
570	  /** Poison damage: armor-bypassing but never lethal (floors at half a heart). */
571	  private applyPoisonDamage = (amount: number): void => {
572	    if (applyNonLethalDamage(this.state, amount, POISON_FLOOR_HP)) this.emit({ type: "playerHurt" });
573	  };
574	
575	  private removeMobAt = (index: number): void => {
576	    const state = this.state;
577	    const mob = state.mobs[index];
578	    state.mobs.splice(index, 1);
579	    // Babies drop nothing — only grown animals yield loot.
580	    const drops = mob.ageTimer <= 0 ? rollMobDrops(mob.kind, this.rng) : [];
581	    for (const drop of drops) {
582	      state.inventory = inv.adjustSlotCount(state.inventory, drop.itemId, drop.count) ?? state.inventory;
583	    }
584	    // XP on kill, baby-gated like drops; the boss pays a jackpot.
585	    if (mob.ageTimer <= 0) awardXp(state, xpForMob(mob.kind), this.emit);
586	    this.emit({ type: "mobDied", kind: mob.kind, x: mob.position.x, y: mob.position.y, z: mob.position.z });
587	    // Drops land straight in inventory (no ground item), so announce them.
588	    if (drops.length > 0) this.emit({ type: "pickedUp", items: drops });
589	    // Defeating the boss is the win condition — fire the one-shot victory.
590	    if (mob.kind === "boss") {
591	      state.victory = true;
592	      this.emit({ type: "bossDefeated", x: mob.position.x, y: mob.position.y, z: mob.position.z });
593	    }
594	  };
595	
596	  /**
597	   * Summons the boss from a held Cursed Totem at a seeded land point near the
598	   * player, consuming the totem. Refuses (keeping the totem) when a boss already
599	   * walks. Returns true when the click was consumed.
600	   */
601	  private trySummonBoss(): boolean {
602	    const state = this.state;
603	    const slot = state.inventory[state.selectedSlot];
604	    if (slot?.id !== "boss_summoner" || slot.count <= 0) return false;
605	    if (state.mobs.some((mob) => mob.kind === "boss")) {
606	      this.emit({ type: "summonFailed" });
607	      return true;
608	    }
609	    const point = randomLandPointNear(state.world, this.surfaceYAt, state.player.position.x, state.player.position.z, BOSS_SUMMON_RADIUS, this.rng);
610	    spawnBoss(state, point.x, point.y, point.z, this.rng);
611	    state.inventory = inv.adjustSlotCount(state.inventory, "boss_summoner", -1, state.selectedSlot) ?? state.inventory;
612	    this.emit({ type: "bossSummoned", x: point.x, y: point.y, z: point.z });
613	    return true;
614	  }
615	
616	  private get mobTickDeps() {
617	    return {
618	      surfaceYAt: this.surfaceYAt,
619	      applyDamage: this.applyDamage,
620	      removeMobAt: this.removeMobAt,
621	      rng: this.rng,
622	      emit: this.emit
623	    };
624	  }
625	
626	  private forceUnstuck(): void {
627	    const state = this.state;
628	    const safe = findSpawnOnLand(state.world, state.player.position.x, state.player.position.z, true);
629	    state.player.position.set(safe.x, safe.y, safe.z);
630	    state.player.velocity.set(0, 0, 0);
631	    state.player.onGround = false;
632	    state.worldMeshDirty = true;
633	  }
634	
635	  private respawn(): void {
636	    const state = this.state;
637	    const bed = state.spawnPoint;
638	    if (bed && state.world.get(bed.x, bed.y, bed.z) === BlockId.Bed) {
639	      // Respawn standing on the bed; the bed block is non-solid head room above it.
640	      state.player.position.set(bed.x + 0.5, bed.y + 1.05, bed.z + 0.5);
641	    } else {
642	      const spawn = randomLandPointNear(state.world, this.surfaceYAt, state.world.sizeX / 2, state.world.sizeZ / 2, RENDER_RADIUS * 0.9, this.rng);
643	      state.player.position.set(spawn.x, spawn.y + 2, spawn.z);
644	    }
645	    state.player.velocity.set(0, 0, 0);
646	    state.player.pitch = 0;
647	    clearEffects(state);
648	    resetMining(state);
649	    state.thrownSpears = [];
650	    state.fishing = null;
651	    state.worldMeshDirty = true;
652	    this.events.push({ type: "respawned" });
653	  }
654	
655	  /** Advances the day clock to the next morning after a sleep completes. */
656	  private wakeToMorning(): void {
657	    const state = this.state;
658	    const nextDay = Math.floor(state.dayClock / DAY_CYCLE_SECONDS) + 1;
659	    state.dayClock = (nextDay + WAKE_DAY_PHASE) * DAY_CYCLE_SECONDS;
660	    state.daylight = daylightAt(state.dayClock);
661	    state.daylightPercent = Math.round(state.daylight * 100);
662	    this.emit({ type: "wokeUp" });
663	  }
664	
665	  /** Unequips armor that left the inventory (broken or dropped). */
666	  private syncEquippedArmor(): void {
667	    const state = this.state;
668	    state.equippedArmor = inv.unequipMissingArmor(state.inventory, state.equippedArmor) ?? state.equippedArmor;
669	  }
670	
671	  /** Refreshes the F3 readout at ~4 Hz so React is not re-rendered every frame. */
672	  private tickDebugInfo(dt: number): void {
673	    const state = this.state;
674	    if (!state.debugOpen) return;
675	    state.timers.debugHudTimer += dt;
676	    if (state.timers.debugHudTimer < 0.25) return;
677	    state.timers.debugHudTimer = 0;
678	    state.debugInfo = this.currentDebugInfo();
679	  }
680	
681	  private currentDebugInfo() {
682	    const { player, daylight } = this.state;
683	    return {
684	      x: Math.round(player.position.x * 10) / 10,
685	      y: Math.round(player.position.y * 10) / 10,
686	      z: Math.round(player.position.z * 10) / 10,
687	      daylight: Math.round(daylight * 100) / 100
688	    };
689	  }
690	
691	  /** Boss HUD data as a ref-stable object, rebuilt only when a visible rounded value moves. */
692	  private bossSnapshot(): ({ hpPercent: number } & BossTracking) | null {
693	    const bossMob = this.state.mobs.find((mob) => mob.kind === "boss");
694	    if (!bossMob) {
695	      if (this.lastBoss !== null) this.lastBoss = null;
696	      return null;
697	    }
698	    const percent = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, Math.round((bossMob.hp / BOSS_HP) * 100) / 100));
699	    const tracking = bossTracking(this.state.player, bossMob);
700	    if (
701	      !this.lastBoss ||
702	      percent !== this.lastBoss.hpPercent ||
703	      tracking.bearingDegrees !== this.lastBoss.bearingDegrees ||
704	      tracking.distanceBlocks !== this.lastBoss.distanceBlocks
705	    ) {
706	      this.lastBoss = { hpPercent: percent, ...tracking };
707	    }
708	    return this.lastBoss;
709	  }
710	
711	  /**
712	   * Active effects as a ref-stable array, rebuilt only when the visible content
713	   * (ids or rounded seconds) changes — `Math.ceil(remaining)` only moves on
714	   * integer-second boundaries, so the HUD countdown re-renders ~1 Hz, not 60 Hz.
715	   */
716	  private effectsProjection(): GameSnapshot["activeEffects"] {
717	    const next: GameSnapshot["activeEffects"] = [];
718	    for (const id of EFFECT_ORDER) {
719	      const remaining = this.state.effects.get(id);
720	      if (remaining && remaining > 0) next.push({ id, seconds: Math.ceil(remaining) });
721	    }
722	    const key = next.map((entry) => `${entry.id}:${entry.seconds}`).join(",");
723	    if (key !== this.lastEffectsKey) {
724	      this.lastEffectsKey = key;
725	      this.lastEffects = next;
726	    }
727	    return this.lastEffects;
728	  }
729	
730	  private buildSnapshot(): GameSnapshot {
731	    const state = this.state;
732	    return {
733	      api: this,
734	      inventory: state.inventory,
735	      equippedArmor: state.equippedArmor,
736	      selectedSlot: state.selectedSlot,
737	      hearts: state.hearts,
738	      hunger: state.hunger,
739	      oxygen: state.oxygen,
740	      daylightPercent: state.daylightPercent,
741	      passiveCount: state.mobs.reduce((acc, mob) => acc + (mob.hostile ? 0 : 1), 0),
742	      hostileCount: state.mobs.reduce((acc, mob) => acc + (mob.hostile ? 1 : 0), 0),
743	      respawnSeconds: state.isDead ? Math.max(0, Math.ceil(state.respawnTimer)) : 0,
744	      inventoryOpen: state.inventoryOpen,
745	      paused: state.paused,
746	      debugOpen: state.debugOpen,
747	      debug: state.debugInfo,
748	      cameraMode: state.cameraMode,
749	      armorPoints: inv.equippedDefense(state.inventory, state.equippedArmor),
750	      capsActive: state.capsActive,
751	      sleeping: state.sleepTimer > 0,
752	      craftingStation: state.craftingStation,
753	      container: state.openContainerIndex !== null ? (state.containers.get(state.openContainerIndex) ?? null) : null,
754	      boss: this.bossSnapshot(),
755	      victory: state.victory,
756	      activeEffects: this.effectsProjection(),
757	      xpLevel: xpLevel(state.xp),
758	      xpProgress: xpProgress(state.xp)
759	    };
760	  }
761	
762	  private refreshSnapshot(): void {
763	    const next = this.buildSnapshot();
764	    const prev = this.snapshot;
765	    const changed = (Object.keys(next) as Array<keyof GameSnapshot>).some((key) => next[key] !== prev[key]);
766	    if (!changed) return;
767	    this.snapshot = next;
768	    for (const listener of this.listeners) listener();
769	  }
770	}
771

{

  "content": "/**\n * Game modes — the four Minecraft-style ways to play, a single per-player axis\n * the player picks at world creation and can switch in the pause menu:\n *\n * - **survival**  — the original game: gather, craft, fight, take damage.\n * - **creative**  — fly, build with unlimited blocks, invulnerable, instant break.\n * - **adventure** — survival, but terrain can't be broken or placed.\n * - **spectator** — fly through everything, unseen and unable to interact.\n *\n * Difficulty (Peaceful) and the Hardcore flag are deliberately *not* modeled\n * here — they're orthogonal axes deferred to a later change.\n *\n * Systems gate on the **predicates** below (intent: \"can this mode edit\n * blocks?\") rather than comparing the raw id, so a new mode only has to answer\n * the predicates and every call site keeps working.\n */\nexport type GameMode = \"survival\" | \"creative\" | \"adventure\" | \"spectator\";\n\nexport const GAME_MODE_IDS: readonly GameMode[] = [\"survival\", \"creative\", \"adventure\", \"spectator\"];\n\n/** Coerces a stored/UI value to a GameMode; unknown values are not game modes. */\nexport function isGameMode(value: unknown): value is GameMode {\n  return typeof value === \"string\" && (GAME_MODE_IDS as readonly string[]).includes(value);\n}\n\n/** UI metadata for the game-mode picker (creation form + pause menu). */\nexport const GAME_MODE_PRESETS: ReadonlyArray<{ id: GameMode; label: string; blurb: string }> = [\n  { id: \"survival\", label: \"Survival\", blurb: \"Gather, craft, fight, survive\" },\n  { id: \"creative\", label: \"Creative\", blurb: \"Fly and build with unlimited blocks\" },\n  { id: \"adventure\", label: \"Adventure\", blurb: \"Explore and fight — no terrain editing\" },\n  { id: \"spectator\", label: \"Spectator\", blurb: \"Fly through the world, unseen\" }\n];\n\n// --- Mode predicates: gate systems on intent, never on the raw id. ---\n\n/** Survival/Adventure take environmental + combat damage; Creative/Spectator are invulnerable. */\nexport function takesDamage(mode: GameMode): boolean {\n  return mode === \"survival\" || mode === \"adventure\";\n}\n\n/** Survival/Creative may break and place blocks; Adventure/Spectator cannot. */\nexport function canEditBlocks(mode: GameMode): boolean {\n  return mode === \"survival\" || mode === \"creative\";\n}\n\n/** Creative breaks instantly and places without consuming items (no drops, no durability). */\nexport function freeBuild(mode: GameMode): boolean {\n  return mode === \"creative\";\n}\n\n/** Every mode but Spectator can interact with the world (attack, doors, chests, trade, eat, fish). */\nexport function canInteract(mode: GameMode): boolean {\n  return mode !== \"spectator\";\n}\n\n/** Creative and Spectator can fly (Spectator always; Creative on toggle). */\nexport function canFly(mode: GameMode): boolean {\n  return mode === \"creative\" || mode === \"spectator\";\n}\n\n/** Spectator passes through terrain (no collision). */\nexport function isNoclip(mode: GameMode): boolean {\n  return mode === \"spectator\";\n}\n\n/** Every mode but Spectator carries a usable inventory/hotbar. */\nexport function usesInventory(mode: GameMode): boolean {\n  return mode !== \"spectator\";\n}\n\n/** Hostiles spawn against / aggro / damage the player only in Survival and Adventure. */\nexport function mobsThreaten(mode: GameMode): boolean {\n  return mode === \"survival\" || mode === \"adventure\";\n}\n"
}

edit: boolean; free: boolean; interact: boolean; fly: boolean; noclip: boolean; inv: boolean; threat: boolean }> = {\n    survival: { damage: true, edit: true, free: false, interact: true, fly: false, noclip: false, inv: true, threat: true },\n    creative: { damage: false, edit: true, free: true, interact: true, fly: true, noclip: false, inv: true, threat: false },\n    adventure: { damage: true, edit: false, free: false, interact: true, fly: false, noclip: false, inv: true, threat: true },\n    spectator: { damage: false, edit: false, free: false, interact: false, fly: true, noclip: true, inv: false, threat: false }\n  };\n\n  for (const mode of GAME_MODE_IDS) {\n    test(`${mode} predicates`, () => {\n      const row = table[mode];\n      expect(takesDamage(mode)).toBe(row.damage);\n      expect(canEditBlocks(mode)).toBe(row.edit);\n      expect(freeBuild(mode)).toBe(row.free);\n      expect(canInteract(mode)).toBe(row.interact);\n      expect(canFly(mode)).toBe(row.fly);\n      expect(isNoclip(mode)).toBe(row.noclip);\n      expect(usesInventory(mode)).toBe(row.inv);\n      expect(mobsThreaten(mode)).toBe(row.threat);\n    });\n  }\n});\n"

35	/** Horizontal forward direction for a yaw angle (camera order YXZ, looking down -Z). */
36	export function forwardFromYaw(yaw: number, out: THREE.Vector3): THREE.Vector3 {

42	  const cp = Math.cos(pitch);
43	  return out.set(-cp * Math.sin(yaw), Math.sin(pitch), -cp * Math.cos(yaw));
44	}

46	export function tickPlayerMotion(state: GameState, input: FrameInput, dt: number, applyDamage: (amount: number) => void): MoveTickResult {
47	  const { world, player, timers } = state;
48	  const keys = input.keys;
49	
50	  const stepAxis = (axis: "x" | "y" | "z", amount: number) => {
51	    const stepSize = 0.05 * Math.sign(amount);
52	    let remaining = amount;
53	    while (Math.abs(remaining) > 1e-6) {
54	      const step = Math.abs(remaining) > Math.abs(stepSize) ? stepSize : remaining;
55	      player.position[axis] += step;
56	      if (collidesAt(world, player.position, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT)) {
57	        player.position[axis] -= step;
58	        if (axis === "y" && step < 0) player.onGround = true;
59	        if (axis === "y") player.velocity.y = 0;
60	        break;
61	      }
62	      remaining -= step;
63	    }
64	  };
65	
66	  const forwardInput = (keys.has("KeyW") ? 1 : 0) - (keys.has("KeyS") ? 1 : 0);
67	  const strafeInput = (keys.has("KeyD") ? 1 : 0) - (keys.has("KeyA") ? 1 : 0);
68	  const wantsJump = keys.has("Space");
69	  const crouching = keys.has("KeyC");
70	
71	  forwardFromYaw(player.yaw, scratchForward);
72	  scratchRight.crossVectors(scratchForward, UP).normalize();

75	  scratchMoveDir.addScaledVector(scratchRight, strafeInput);
76	  if (scratchMoveDir.lengthSq() > 0) scratchMoveDir.normalize();

88	  player.velocity.y -= GRAVITY * dt;
89	  let didJump = false;
90	  if (wantsJump && player.onGround && !crouching) {
91	    player.velocity.y = JUMP_VELOCITY;
92	    player.onGround = false;
93	    didJump = true;
94	  }
95	
96	  const vyBeforeMove = player.velocity.y;
97	  const startX = player.position.x;
98	  const startZ = player.position.z;
99	  const prevX = player.position.x;
100	  const prevZ = player.position.z;
101	
102	  player.onGround = false;
103	  stepAxis("x", player.velocity.x * dt);
104	  stepAxis("z", player.velocity.z * dt);
105	  stepAxis("y", player.velocity.y * dt);
106	
107	  // Depenetration: if still colliding after movement, nudge up
108	  if (collidesAt(world, player.position, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT)) {
109	    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 1) {
110	      player.position.y += 0.2;
111	      if (!collidesAt(world, player.position, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT)) break;
112	    }
113	  }
114	
115	  if (crouching && (player.onGround || wasGrounded) && !hasSupportUnderPlayer(world, player.position, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH + 0.12)) {
116	    player.position.x = prevX;
117	    player.position.z = prevZ;
118	    player.velocity.x = 0;
119	    player.velocity.z = 0;
120	  }
121	
122	  player.position.x = Math.min(world.sizeX - WORLD_BORDER_PADDING, Math.max(WORLD_BORDER_PADDING, player.position.x));
123	  player.position.z = Math.min(world.sizeZ - WORLD_BORDER_PADDING, Math.max(WORLD_BORDER_PADDING, player.position.z));
124	
125	  if (!wasGrounded && player.onGround && vyBeforeMove < -14) {
126	    // Any fall hard enough to trigger this deals at least half a heart.
127	    applyDamage(Math.max(1, Math.min(19, Math.floor((-vyBeforeMove - 13) * 0.5))));
128	  }
129	
130	  const inVoid = player.position.y < -4;
131	  if (inVoid) {
132	    timers.voidTimer += dt;
133	    if (timers.voidTimer >= 0.4) {
134	      applyDamage(1);
135	      timers.voidTimer = 0;
136	    }
137	  } else {
138	    timers.voidTimer = 0;
139	  }
140	
141	  const horizontalDistance = Math.hypot(player.position.x - startX, player.position.z - startZ);
142	  const moving = horizontalDistance > 1e-4;
143	  const didSprint = sprinting && moving;
144	  const didWalk = !didSprint && moving;
145	  const didLand = !wasGrounded && player.onGround && vyBeforeMove < 0;
146	  return { didSprint, didWalk, didJump, didLand, landImpact: didLand ? -vyBeforeMove : 0, horizontalDistance };
147	}

5	/**
6	 * Applies armor-mitigated damage (always at least 1) and wears equipped armor.
7	 * Returns true when the hit was lethal — the engine emits the death event.
8	 */
9	export function applyDamageWithArmor(state: GameState, amount: number, rng?: () => number): boolean {
10	  if (state.isDead) return false;
11	  const value = Math.max(0, Math.floor(amount));
12	  if (value <= 0) return false;
13	
14	  state.inventory = consumeEquippedArmorDurability(state.inventory, state.equippedArmor, 1, rng) ?? state.inventory;
15	  const reduction = armorReduction(state.inventory, state.equippedArmor);
16	  const mitigated = Math.max(1, Math.floor(value * (1 - reduction)));
17	
18	  state.hearts = Math.max(0, state.hearts - mitigated);
19	  if (state.hearts > 0) return false;
20	
21	  state.isDead = true;
22	  state.respawnTimer = RESPAWN_SECONDS;
23	  return true;
24	}
25	
26	/** Applies environmental damage exactly, bypassing armor and durability wear. */
27	export function applyUnmitigatedDamage(state: GameState, amount: number): boolean {
28	  if (state.isDead) return false;
29	  const value = Math.max(0, Math.floor(amount));
30	  if (value <= 0) return false;
31	
32	  state.hearts = Math.max(0, state.hearts - value);
33	  if (state.hearts > 0) return false;
34	
35	  state.isDead = true;
36	  state.respawnTimer = RESPAWN_SECONDS;
37	  return true;
38	}
39	
40	/**
41	 * Applies armor-bypassing damage that can never be lethal: hearts never drop
42	 * below `floorHp`. Used by Poison, which should chip a player down to half a
43	 * heart yet never deliver the killing blow. Returns true when any damage landed.
44	 */
45	export function applyNonLethalDamage(state: GameState, amount: number, floorHp = 1): boolean {
46	  if (state.isDead) return false;
47	  const value = Math.max(0, Math.floor(amount));
48	  if (value <= 0 || state.hearts <= floorHp) return false;
49	  state.hearts = Math.max(floorHp, state.hearts - value);
50	  return true;
51	}
52	
53	/**
54	 * Counts down the respawn timer while dead. Returns true when the player
55	 * comes back to life this tick — the engine then performs the respawn.
56	 */
57	export function tickRespawnTimer(state: GameState, dt: number): boolean {
58	  if (!state.isDead) return false;
59	  state.respawnTimer -= dt;
60	  if (state.respawnTimer > 0) return false;
61	
62	  state.hearts = MAX_HEARTS;
63	  state.hunger = MAX_HUNGER;
64	  state.isDead = false;
65	  state.respawnTimer = 0;
66	  state.timers.waterExposureTimer = 0;
67	  state.timers.waterDamageTimer = 0;
68	  return true;
69	}

16	function eyePosition(state: GameState, out: THREE.Vector3): THREE.Vector3 {

21	export function selectedTool(state: GameState): InventorySlot | null {

23	  return slot?.kind === "tool" && slot.count > 0 ? slot : null;
24	}

26	export function canMineBlock(block: BlockId, toolTier: number): boolean {
27	  if (block === BlockId.Stone || block === BlockId.Cobblestone || block === BlockId.Brick) return toolTier >= 1;
28	  if (block === BlockId.CoalOre) return toolTier >= 1;
29	  if (block === BlockId.SliverOre) return toolTier >= 2;
30	  if (block === BlockId.RubyOre) return toolTier >= 3;
31	  if (block === BlockId.GoldOre) return toolTier >= 3;
32	  if (block === BlockId.SapphireOre) return toolTier >= 4;
33	  if (block === BlockId.DiamondOre) return toolTier >= 4;
34	  return true;
35	}
36	
37	export function miningSpeed(tool: InventorySlot | null): number {
38	  return (tool?.minePower ?? BARE_HAND_MINE_POWER) * efficiencyMultiplier(tool);
39	}
40	
41	export function resetMining(state: GameState): void {
42	  state.mining.targetKey = "";
43	  state.mining.progress = 0;
44	}
45	
46	function addBlockDrop(state: GameState, block: BlockId, rng: () => number): void {
47	  for (const drop of rollBlockDrops(block, rng)) {
48	    state.inventory = adjustSlotCount(state.inventory, drop.itemId, drop.count) ?? state.inventory;
49	  }
50	}

52	/**
53	 * Empties a broken chest into the inventory. Returns true if the break may
54	 * proceed (the chest was empty, or its contents all fit), false to refuse it
55	 * (no room — the chest is left intact). On success the container entry is
56	 * removed and a pickedUp toast announces what was retrieved.
57	 */
58	function spillChestOnBreak(state: GameState, idx: number, emit: EmitGameEvent): boolean {
59	  // Breaking an unopened dungeon chest still pays out its loot.
60	  fillDungeonChestIfUnlooted(state, idx);
61	  const container = state.containers.get(idx);
62	  const items = container?.filter((slot) => slot.id && slot.count > 0) ?? [];
63	  if (items.length > 0) {
64	    const merged = tryInsertSlots(state.inventory, items);
65	    if (!merged) {
66	      emit({ type: "breakBlocked", reason: "containerFull" });
67	      return false;
68	    }
69	    state.inventory = merged;
70	    const picked = new Map<string, number>();
71	    for (const slot of items) picked.set(slot.id!, (picked.get(slot.id!) ?? 0) + slot.count);
72	    emit({ type: "pickedUp", items: [...picked].map(([itemId, count]) => ({ itemId, count })) });
73	  }
74	  state.containers.delete(idx);
75	  return true;
76	}

78	/** Advances mining progress while the mouse is held; breaks the block at full progress. */
79	export function tickMining(state: GameState, input: FrameInput, dt: number, emit: EmitGameEvent, rng: () => number): void {
80	  if (!input.leftMouseHeld) {
81	    // Releasing the button abandons progress (matching the crack overlay).
82	    if (state.mining.progress > 0) resetMining(state);
83	    return;
84	  }
85	  if (state.inventoryOpen || state.isDead || !input.pointerLocked) return;
86	
87	  const { world, mining } = state;
88	  const origin = eyePosition(state, scratchEye);
89	  const direction = lookDirection(state.player.yaw, state.player.pitch, scratchDir);
90	  const result = voxelRaycast(world, origin, direction, MINE_REACH);
91	  if (!result) {
92	    resetMining(state);
93	    return;
94	  }
95	
96	  const bx = result.hit.x;
97	  const by = result.hit.y;
98	  const bz = result.hit.z;
99	  const targetBlock = world.get(bx, by, bz);
100	  const tool = selectedTool(state);
101	  const tier = tool?.mineTier ?? 0;
102	
103	  if (targetBlock === BlockId.Bedrock || targetBlock === BlockId.Air || !canMineBlock(targetBlock as BlockId, tier)) {
104	    resetMining(state);
105	    return;
106	  }
107	
108	  const key = `${bx},${by},${bz}`;
109	  if (mining.targetKey !== key) {
110	    mining.targetKey = key;
111	    mining.progress = 0;
112	  }
113	
114	  const hardness = BREAK_HARDNESS[targetBlock as BlockId] ?? 2;
115	  mining.progress += dt * miningSpeed(tool) * MINING_RATE;
116	  if (mining.progress < hardness) return;
117	
118	  // Breaking a chest empties it into the inventory first; if it does not all
119	  // fit, refuse the break so nothing is lost (the chest stays intact).
120	  if (targetBlock === BlockId.Chest && !spillChestOnBreak(state, world.index(bx, by, bz), emit)) {
121	    resetMining(state);
122	    return;
123	  }
124	
125	  if (isDoorBlock(targetBlock)) {
126	    const door = doorState(targetBlock)!;
127	    const other = doorState(world.get(bx, door.upper ? by - 1 : by + 1, bz));
128	    state.blockChanges.set(bx, by, bz, BlockId.Air);
129	    if (other && other.upper !== door.upper) {
130	      state.blockChanges.set(bx, door.upper ? by - 1 : by + 1, bz, BlockId.Air);
131	    }
132	  } else {
133	    state.blockChanges.set(bx, by, bz, BlockId.Air);
134	  }
135	  if (tool) state.inventory = consumeToolDurability(state.inventory, state.selectedSlot, 1, rng) ?? state.inventory;
136	  addBlockDrop(state, targetBlock as BlockId, rng);
137	  awardXp(state, xpForBlock(targetBlock as BlockId), emit); // ore blocks grant XP; everything else is 0
138	  state.worldMeshDirty = true;
139	  resetMining(state);
140	  emit({ type: "blockBroken", blockId: targetBlock as BlockId, x: bx, y: by, z: bz });
141	}

143	/** Places the selected block against the targeted face, refusing self-entombment. */
144	export function placeSelectedBlock(state: GameState, emit: EmitGameEvent): void {
145	  const { world } = state;
146	  const origin = eyePosition(state, scratchEye);
147	  const direction = lookDirection(state.player.yaw, state.player.pitch, scratchDir);
148	  const result = voxelRaycast(world, origin, direction, MINE_REACH);
149	  if (!result) return;
150	
151	  const tx = result.previous.x;
152	  const ty = result.previous.y;
153	  const tz = result.previous.z;
154	  if (!world.inBounds(tx, ty, tz)) return;
155	  const replacedBlock = world.get(tx, ty, tz);
156	  if (replacedBlock !== BlockId.Air && replacedBlock !== BlockId.Water) return;
157	
158	  const slot = state.inventory[state.selectedSlot];
159	  if (!slot || !slot.id || slot.kind !== "block" || slot.count <= 0 || slot.blockId === undefined) return;
160	  if (slot.blockId === BlockId.Bedrock) return;
161	
162	  const afterTake = adjustSlotCount(state.inventory, slot.id, -1, state.selectedSlot);
163	  if (!afterTake) return;
164	  state.inventory = afterTake;
165	  let replacedUpper: BlockId | null = null;
166	  if (slot.id === "door") {
167	    const support = world.get(tx, ty - 1, tz);
168	    replacedUpper = world.get(tx, ty + 1, tz) as BlockId;
169	    if (ty + 1 >= world.sizeY || (replacedUpper !== BlockId.Air && replacedUpper !== BlockId.Water) || !world.isSolid(tx, ty - 1, tz) || isDoorBlock(support)) {
170	      state.inventory = adjustSlotCount(state.inventory, slot.id, 1, state.selectedSlot) ?? state.inventory;
171	      return;
172	    }
173	    const facing = doorFacingFromYaw(state.player.yaw);
174	    state.blockChanges.set(tx, ty, tz, doorBlock(facing, false, false));
175	    state.blockChanges.set(tx, ty + 1, tz, doorBlock(facing, false, true));
176	  } else {
177	    state.blockChanges.set(tx, ty, tz, slot.blockId);
178	  }
179	  if (collidesAt(world, state.player.position, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT)) {
180	    state.blockChanges.set(tx, ty, tz, replacedBlock as BlockId);
181	    if (replacedUpper !== null) state.blockChanges.set(tx, ty + 1, tz, replacedUpper);
182	    state.inventory = adjustSlotCount(state.inventory, slot.id, 1, state.selectedSlot) ?? state.inventory;
183	    return;
184	  }
185	
186	  // A placed chest gets a fresh, empty block-entity store.
187	  if (slot.blockId === BlockId.Chest) {
188	    state.containers.set(
189	      world.index(tx, ty, tz),
190	      Array.from({ length: CHEST_SLOTS }, () => createEmptySlot())
191	    );
192	  }
193	
194	  state.worldMeshDirty = true;
195	  emit({ type: "blockPlaced", blockId: slot.blockId, x: tx, y: ty, z: tz });
196	}
197

1	import type { GameEngine } from "@/lib/game/engine/GameEngine";
2	import type { FrameInput } from "@/lib/game/engine/state";

4	const MOUSE_SENSITIVITY = 0.0021;
5	
6	type MutableInput = {
7	  keys: Set<string>;
8	  capsActive: boolean;
9	  leftMouseHeld: boolean;
10	  pointerLocked: boolean;
11	};
12	
13	export type InputController = {
14	  /** Live continuous-input view, passed to engine.step every frame. */
15	  readonly input: FrameInput;
16	  /** Drops held keys and the mouse button (on death/respawn). */
17	  clearKeys(): void;
18	  dispose(): void;
19	};
20	
21	type CreateInputControllerArgs = {
22	  /** The WebGL canvas — pointer lock target. */
23	  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement;
24	  engine: GameEngine;
25	  onResize: () => void;
26	  onLockChange: (locked: boolean) => void;
27	};
28	
29	/**
30	 * Owns every DOM listener. Continuous input (keys, mouse button, pointer
31	 * lock) is exposed as a FrameInput the engine reads each step; discrete
32	 * actions become engine commands; mouse-look goes through engine.applyLook.
33	 */
34	export function createInputController(args: CreateInputControllerArgs): InputController {
35	  const { canvas, engine, onResize, onLockChange } = args;
36	
37	  const input: MutableInput = {
38	    keys: new Set<string>(),
39	    capsActive: false,
40	    leftMouseHeld: false,
41	    pointerLocked: false
42	  };
43	
44	  const uiBlocked = () => engine.state.inventoryOpen || engine.state.isDead || engine.state.paused;
45	
46	  const onMouseMove = (evt: MouseEvent) => {
47	    if (!input.pointerLocked) return;
48	    engine.applyLook(-evt.movementX * MOUSE_SENSITIVITY, -evt.movementY * MOUSE_SENSITIVITY);
49	  };
50	
51	  const onKeyDown = (evt: KeyboardEvent) => {
52	    // Escape under pointer lock never reaches us — the browser consumes it to
53	    // exit the lock, and the pointerlockchange handler below opens the menu.
54	    if (evt.code === "Escape") {
55	      if (engine.state.paused) engine.dispatch({ type: "resume" });
56	      else if (engine.state.inventoryOpen) engine.dispatch({ type: "toggleInventory" });
57	      else if (!input.pointerLocked) engine.dispatch({ type: "pause" });
58	      return;
59	    }
60	
61	    // Render-only and engine-supported in every state, so it works even from
62	    // the pause menu — like Minecraft's F5.
63	    if (evt.code === "KeyV") {
64	      engine.dispatch({ type: "toggleCameraView" });
65	      return;
66	    }
67	
68	    if (engine.state.paused) return;
69	
70	    if (evt.code === "F3") {
71	      evt.preventDefault();
72	      engine.dispatch({ type: "toggleDebug" });
73	      return;
74	    }
75	
76	    if (evt.code.startsWith("Digit")) {
77	      const idx = Number.parseInt(evt.code.slice(5), 10) - 1;
78	      if (idx >= 0) engine.dispatch({ type: "selectSlot", index: idx });
79	    }
80	
81	    if (evt.code === "KeyI") {
82	      engine.dispatch({ type: "toggleInventory" });
83	      input.keys.clear();
84	      if (input.pointerLocked) document.exitPointerLock();
85	      return;
86	    }
87	
88	    // Shift-gated so a stray `U` can't teleport the player mid-play; the 0.8s
89	    // auto-unstuck safeguard still covers genuine wedged-in-terrain cases.
90	    if (evt.shiftKey && evt.code === "KeyU") {
91	      engine.dispatch({ type: "unstuck" });
92	      return;
93	    }
94	
95	    if (uiBlocked()) return;
96	
97	    if (evt.code === "KeyE") {
98	      evt.preventDefault();
99	      engine.dispatch({ type: "placeBlock" });
100	    }
101	    if (evt.code === "KeyF") {
102	      evt.preventDefault();
103	      // One key for consumables: a held potion is drunk for its effect, anything else is eaten.
104	      const held = engine.state.inventory[engine.state.selectedSlot];
105	      engine.dispatch({ type: held?.effect ? "drinkPotion" : "eatFood" });
106	    }
107	
108	    input.keys.add(evt.code);
109	    input.capsActive = evt.getModifierState("CapsLock");
110	    if (evt.code === "Space") evt.preventDefault();
111	  };
112	
113	  const onKeyUp = (evt: KeyboardEvent) => {
114	    input.keys.delete(evt.code);
115	    input.capsActive = evt.getModifierState("CapsLock");
116	  };
117	
118	  const onMouseDown = (evt: MouseEvent) => {
119	    if (uiBlocked()) return;
120	    if (!input.pointerLocked) return;
121	
122	    if (evt.button === 0) {
123	      input.leftMouseHeld = true;
124	      engine.dispatch({ type: "attack" });
125	    }
126	    if (evt.button === 2) engine.dispatch({ type: "placeBlock" });
127	  };
128	
129	  const onDoubleClick = () => {
130	    if (uiBlocked() || input.pointerLocked) return;
131	    // Starting play is deliberate: a single click remains inert, while the
132	    // double-click gesture acquires pointer lock without also mining.
133	    // The request can legitimately reject (recent Esc, unfocused document,
134	    // headless browsers); the game just stays unlocked.
135	    Promise.resolve(canvas.requestPointerLock()).catch(() => {});
136	  };
137	
138	  const onMouseUp = (evt: MouseEvent) => {
139	    if (evt.button !== 0) return;
140	    input.leftMouseHeld = false;
141	  };
142	
143	  const onContextMenu = (evt: MouseEvent) => evt.preventDefault();
144	
145	  const onPointerLockChange = () => {
146	    input.pointerLocked = document.pointerLockElement === canvas;
147	    onLockChange(input.pointerLocked);
148	    // Losing the lock during plain gameplay means the player pressed Escape
149	    // (or the browser took it away) — open the pause menu. The inventory and
150	    // death paths set their state flags before the lock change fires, and the
151	    // pause command itself ignores those states as a second guard.
152	    if (!input.pointerLocked) engine.dispatch({ type: "pause" });
153	  };
154	
155	  window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
156	  document.addEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove);
157	  document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
158	  document.addEventListener("keyup", onKeyUp);
159	  document.addEventListener("mousedown", onMouseDown);
160	  document.addEventListener("dblclick", onDoubleClick);
161	  document.addEventListener("mouseup", onMouseUp);
162	  document.addEventListener("contextmenu", onContextMenu);
163	  document.addEventListener("pointerlockchange", onPointerLockChange);
164	
165	  return {
166	    input,
167	
168	    clearKeys() {
169	      input.keys.clear();
170	      input.leftMouseHeld = false;
171	    },
172	
173	    dispose() {
174	      window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize);
175	      document.removeEventListener("mousemove", onMouseMove);
176	      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
177	      document.removeEventListener("keyup", onKeyUp);
178	      document.removeEventListener("mousedown", onMouseDown);
179	      document.removeEventListener("dblclick", onDoubleClick);
180	      document.removeEventListener("mouseup", onMouseUp);
181	      document.removeEventListener("contextmenu", onContextMenu);
182	      document.removeEventListener("pointerlockchange", onPointerLockChange);
183	    }
184	  };
185	}
186

38	 * Headless simulation tests: the engine boots a real generated world and runs

42	function mulberry32(seed: number): () => number {
43	  let t = seed >>> 0;
44	  return () => {
45	    t += 0x6d2b79f5;
46	    let r = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), 1 | t);

FILE: lib/world/queries.ts
export function voxelRaycast(world: VoxelWorld, origin: THREE.Vector3, direction: THREE.Vector3, maxDist = 6): RaycastResult | null {
  const dir = direction.clone().normalize();
  const pos = origin.clone();

  let x = Math.floor(pos.x);
  let y = Math.floor(pos.y);
  let z = Math.floor(pos.z);

  const stepX = dir.x > 0 ? 1 : -1;
  const stepY = dir.y > 0 ? 1 : -1;
  const stepZ = dir.z > 0 ? 1 : -1;

  const invDx = Math.abs(1 / (dir.x || 1e-6));
  const invDy = Math.abs(1 / (dir.y || 1e-6));
  const invDz = Math.abs(1 / (dir.z || 1e-6));

  let tMaxX = ((stepX > 0 ? x + 1 : x) - pos.x) / (dir.x || 1e-6);
  let tMaxY = ((stepY > 0 ? y + 1 : y) - pos.y) / (dir.y || 1e-6);
  let tMaxZ = ((stepZ > 0 ? z + 1 : z) - pos.z) / (dir.z || 1e-6);
  if (tMaxX < 0) tMaxX += invDx;
  if (tMaxY < 0) tMaxY += invDy;
  if (tMaxZ < 0) tMaxZ += invDz;

  let t = 0;
  let previous = new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);

  while (t <= maxDist) {
    if (world.isSolid(x, y, z)) return { hit: new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z), previous, distance: t };
    previous = new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z);

    if (tMaxX < tMaxY) {
      if (tMaxX < tMaxZ) {
        x += stepX;
        t = tMaxX;
        tMaxX += invDx;
      } else {
        z += stepZ;
        t = tMaxZ;
        tMaxZ += invDz;
      }
    } else if (tMaxY < tMaxZ) {
      y += stepY;
      t = tMaxY;
      tMaxY += invDy;
    } else {
      z += stepZ;
      t = tMaxZ;
      tMaxZ += invDz;
    }
  }

  return null;
}
```

49	function recipeTooltip(recipe: Recipe, inventory: InventorySlot[], locked: boolean, craftable: boolean): TooltipContent {
50	  if (locked) return { title: labelFor(recipe.result.slotId), lines: [`Requires ${STATION_LABELS[recipe.station!]}`] };
51	  if (craftable) return { title: recipe.label };

export function adjustSlotCount(slots: InventorySlot[], slotId: string, delta: number, preferredIndex?: number): InventorySlot[] | null {
  if (!slotId || delta === 0) return null;
  const next = cloneSlots(slots);
  let remaining = Math.abs(delta);

  if (delta < 0) {
    const consumeFromIndex = (index: number) => {
      if (remaining <= 0) return;
      if (index < 0 || index >= next.length) return;
      const slot = next[index];
      if (slot.id !== slotId || slot.count <= 0) return;
      const take = Math.min(remaining, slot.count);
      slot.count -= take;
      remaining -= take;
      if (slot.count <= 0) next[index] = createEmptySlot();
    };

    if (typeof preferredIndex === "number") consumeFromIndex(preferredIndex);
    for (let i = 0; i < next.length && remaining > 0; i += 1) consumeFromIndex(i);
    if (remaining > 0) return null;
    return next;
  }

  if (!ITEM_DEF_BY_ID[slotId]) return null;
  const stackSize = maxStackSizeForItem(slotId);

  const fillIndex = (index: number) => {
    if (remaining <= 0) return;
    if (index < 0 || index >= next.length) return;
    const slot = next[index];
    if (slot.id !== slotId || slot.count >= stackSize) return;
    const add = Math.min(remaining, stackSize - slot.count);
    slot.count += add;
    remaining -= add;
  };

  if (typeof preferredIndex === "number") fillIndex(preferredIndex);
  for (let i = 0; i < next.length && remaining > 0; i += 1) fillIndex(i);
  for (let i = 0; i < next.length && remaining > 0; i += 1) {

Clicking one pulls a full stack into the inventory (the engine\n * gates the give to Creative). Replaces the recipe book while in Creative mode.\n */\nexport default function CreativeInventoryTab({ onGiveItem }: { onGiveItem: (itemId: string) => void }) {\n  const [query, setQuery] = useState(\"\");\n  const { tooltip, bind } = useItemTooltip();\n\n  const groups = useMemo(() => {\n    const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();\n    const matches = ITEM_DEFS.filter((def) => !q || def.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || def.id.includes(q));\n    return KIND_SECTIONS.map((section) => ({ ...section, items: matches.filter((def) => def.kind === section.kind) })).filter((section) => section.items.length > 0);\n  }, [query]);\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"recipe-book creative-palette\">\n      <div className=\"inventory-heading\">Creative</div>\n      <input\n        className=\"creative-search\"\n        type=\"text\"\n        placeholder=\"Search items…\"\n        value={query}\n        onChange={(event) => setQuery(event.target.value)}\n        aria-label=\"Search creative items\"\n      />\n      <div className=\"recipe-list creative-list\">\n        {groups.length === 0 ? <div className=\"creative-empty\">No items match “{query}”.</div> : null}\n        {groups.map((group) => (\n          <Fragment key={group.kind}>\n            <div className=\"recipe-category\" role=\"presentation\">\n              {group.label}\n            </div>\n            <div className=\"inv-grid creative-grid\" data-testid={`creative-${group.kind}`}>\n              {group.items.map((def) => (\n                <button key={def.id} className=\"inv-slot\" onClick={() => onGiveItem(def.id)} {...bind(itemTooltipFor(createSlot(def.id, 1)))} aria-label={`Give ${def.label}`}>\n                  <ItemIcon slot={createSlot(def.id, 1)} size={32} />\n                </button>\n              ))}\n            </div>\n          </Fragment>\n        ))}\n      </div>\n      {tooltip}\n    </div>\n  );\n}\n"

44	/**
45	 * A ranged mob looses an arrow from its eye toward the player's chest, leading a
46	 * moving target by a fraction of the arrow's travel time. The arrow is not
47	 * player-owned, so it only ever hits the player (never the firer or other mobs).
48	 */
49	function fireMobArrow(state: GameState, mob: MobState, damage: number, speed: number, emit: EmitGameEvent): void {
50	  const { player } = state;
51	  const eyeY = mob.position.y + mob.halfHeight * 0.7;
52	  const dist = Math.hypot(player.position.x - mob.position.x, player.position.z - mob.position.z);
53	  const lead = (dist / speed) * SKELETON_LEAD_FACTOR;
54	  scratchAim.set(
55	    player.position.x + player.velocity.x * lead - mob.position.x,
56	    player.position.y + 0.9 - eyeY,
57	    player.position.z + player.velocity.z * lead - mob.position.z
58	  );
59	  spawnArrow(state, mob.position.x, eyeY, mob.position.z, scratchAim, {
60	    speed,
61	    damage,
62	    knockback: MOB_ARROW_KNOCKBACK,
63	    fromPlayer: false,
64	    ttl: ARROW_TTL
65	  });
66	  emit({ type: "mobAttacked", kind: mob.kind });
67	}
68	
69	/** The boss looses a 3-arrow horizontal spread aimed at the player's chest. */
70	function fireBossSpread(state: GameState, mob: MobState, emit: EmitGameEvent): void {
71	  const { player } = state;
72	  const eyeY = mob.position.y + mob.halfHeight * 0.7;
73	  const baseX = player.position.x - mob.position.x;
74	  const baseY = player.position.y + 0.9 - eyeY;
75	  const baseZ = player.position.z - mob.position.z;
76	  for (let spread = -1; spread <= 1; spread += 1) {
77	    scratchAim.set(baseX, baseY, baseZ);
78	    if (spread !== 0) scratchAim.applyAxisAngle(UP, spread * BOSS_SPREAD);
79	    spawnArrow(state, mob.position.x, eyeY, mob.position.z, scratchAim, {
80	      speed: BOSS_ARROW_SPEED,
81	      damage: BOSS_ARROW_DAMAGE,
82	      knockback: MOB_ARROW_KNOCKBACK,
83	      fromPlayer: false,
84	      ttl: ARROW_TTL
85	    });
86	  }
87	  emit({ type: "mobAttacked", kind: mob.kind });
88	}

90	/**
91	 * The boss periodically conjures a skeleton or zombie nearby while it is engaged,
92	 * up to its own minion cap and the shared global hostile cap.
93	 */
94	function tickBossSummon(state: GameState, mob: MobState, dt: number, deps: MobTickDeps): void {
95	  mob.summonTimer = (mob.summonTimer ?? 0) - dt;
96	  if (mob.summonTimer > 0) return;
97	  mob.summonTimer = BOSS_SUMMON_INTERVAL_SECONDS;
98	
99	  let minions = 0;
100	  let hostiles = 0;
101	  for (const other of state.mobs) {
102	    if (!other.hostile) continue;
103	    hostiles += 1;
104	    if (other.kind !== "boss") minions += 1;
105	  }
106	  if (minions >= BOSS_MINION_CAP || hostiles >= HOSTILE_CAP) return;
107	
108	  const kind = deps.rng() < 0.5 ? "skeleton" : "zombie";
109	  const angle = deps.rng() * Math.PI * 2;
110	  const radius = 2 + deps.rng() * 2;
111	  const mx = mob.position.x + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
112	  const mz = mob.position.z + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
113	  const my = deps.surfaceYAt(mx, mz);
114	  pushMob(state, kind, true, mx, my, mz, deps.rng);
115	  deps.emit({ type: "mobSpawned", kind, x: mx, y: my, z: mz });
116	}

119	  surfaceYAt: SurfaceYAtFn;
120	  applyDamage: (amount: number) => void;
121	  removeMobAt: (index: number) => void;
122	  rng: () => number;
123	  emit: EmitGameEvent;
124	};

126	export function tickMobs(state: GameState, dt: number, deps: MobTickDeps): void {
127	  const { world, daylight, mobs, isDead } = state;
128	  const playerPosition = state.player.position;
129	  const playerVelocity = state.player.velocity;
130	
131	  for (let i = 0; i < mobs.length; i += 1) {
132	    const mob = mobs[i];
133	    // A mob killed earlier this tick (e.g. by an explosion) still awaits the
134	    // post-loop sweep — skip its AI so a corpse can't move or land a final hit.
135	    if (mob.hp <= 0) continue;
136	    mob.attackTimer -= dt;
137	    mob.turnTimer -= dt;
138	    const activeHostile = mob.hostile && (mob.kind !== "spider" || daylight < SPIDER_AGGRO_BELOW_DAYLIGHT);
139	
140	    scratchToPlayer.copy(playerPosition).sub(mob.position).setY(0);
141	    const distanceToPlayer = scratchToPlayer.length();
142	    scratchToPlayer3D.copy(playerPosition).sub(mob.position);
143	    const attackDistance = scratchToPlayer3D.length();
144	    const verticalGap = Math.abs(scratchToPlayer3D.y);
145	    let moveSpeed = mob.speed;
146	    const isBoss = mob.kind === "boss";
147	    const isRanged = MOB_TEMPLATES[mob.kind].ranged === true;
148	    let moveSign = 1;
149	
150	    if (activeHostile && distanceToPlayer < mob.detectRange) {
151	      if (distanceToPlayer > 0.001) mob.direction.lerp(scratchToPlayer.normalize(), 0.2).normalize();
152	      moveSpeed *= 1.15;
153	      // Skeletons kite (back off / hold in a standoff band); the boss bears down.
154	      if (isRanged && !isBoss) {
155	        if (distanceToPlayer < SKELETON_STANDOFF_MIN) moveSign = -1;
156	        else if (distanceToPlayer <= SKELETON_STANDOFF_MAX) moveSign = 0;
157	      }
158	    } else if (!mob.hostile && mob.kind !== "villager" && distanceToPlayer < 4.2) {
159	      // Animals flee when you get close; villagers don't, so you can walk up to trade.
160	      if (distanceToPlayer > 0.001) mob.direction.lerp(scratchToPlayer.normalize().multiplyScalar(-1), 0.2).normalize();
161	      moveSpeed *= 1.15;
162	    } else if (mob.turnTimer <= 0) {
163	      mob.direction.applyAxisAngle(UP, (deps.rng() - 0.5) * Math.PI).normalize();
164	      mob.turnTimer = 1.5 + deps.rng() * 4;
165	    }
166	    mob.moveSpeed = moveSpeed;
167	
168	    let nx = mob.position.x + mob.direction.x * moveSpeed * dt * moveSign;
169	    let nz = mob.position.z + mob.direction.z * moveSpeed * dt * moveSign;
170	
171	    if (nx < 2 || nz < 2 || nx > world.sizeX - 2 || nz > world.sizeZ - 2) {
172	      mob.direction.multiplyScalar(-1);
173	      nx = mob.position.x + mob.direction.x * moveSpeed * dt * moveSign;
174	      nz = mob.position.z + mob.direction.z * moveSpeed * dt * moveSign;
175	      mob.turnTimer = 1;
176	    }
177	
178	    let ground = deps.surfaceYAt(nx, nz);
179	    scratchMobFeet.set(nx, ground, nz);
180	    if (collidesAt(world, scratchMobFeet, 0.28, mob.halfHeight * 2)) {
181	      mob.direction.multiplyScalar(-1);
182	      nx = mob.position.x;
183	      nz = mob.position.z;
184	      ground = mob.position.y - mob.halfHeight;
185	      mob.turnTimer = 1;
186	    }
187	    mob.position.set(nx, ground + mob.halfHeight, nz);
188	    mob.yaw = Math.atan2(mob.direction.x, mob.direction.z);
189	
190	    // Ranged mobs shoot from across their detect range; melee mobs (and the boss
191	    // up close) must be adjacent. The boss reaches a little farther for melee.
192	    const meleeReach = isBoss ? BOSS_MELEE_REACH : 4;
193	    const meleeVGap = isBoss ? SKELETON_FIRE_VGAP : 1.6;
194	    const meleeReady = activeHostile && attackDistance < meleeReach && verticalGap < meleeVGap;
195	    const fireReady = isRanged && activeHostile && attackDistance < mob.detectRange && verticalGap < SKELETON_FIRE_VGAP;
196	    // A creeper close enough to light its fuse also needs a line-of-sight check —
197	    // it can be in range with a large vertical gap (so not meleeReady), which
198	    // would otherwise arm the fuse off the default `hasLineOfSight = true`.
199	    const creeperFuseReady = mob.kind === "creeper" && activeHostile && attackDistance < CREEPER_FUSE_RANGE;
200	
201	    let hasLineOfSight = true;
202	    if (meleeReady || fireReady || creeperFuseReady) {
203	      scratchMobEye.set(mob.position.x, mob.position.y + mob.halfHeight * 0.35, mob.position.z);
204	      scratchPlayerAim.set(playerPosition.x, playerPosition.y + 0.9, playerPosition.z);
205	      scratchRay.copy(scratchPlayerAim).sub(scratchMobEye);
206	      if (scratchRay.lengthSq() > 1e-6) {
207	        const hit = voxelRaycast(world, scratchMobEye, scratchRay.normalize(), attackDistance + 0.5);
208	        hasLineOfSight = hit === null;
209	      }
210	    }
211	
212	    // !isDead: mobs keep ticking through the respawn countdown, but attacking a
213	    // corpse should neither sound nor re-arm the attack cooldown.
214	    if (!isDead && (meleeReady || fireReady) && hasLineOfSight && mob.attackTimer <= 0) {
215	      // The boss bites when adjacent, otherwise looses a spread; skeletons only
216	      // ever shoot; melee mobs only ever bite. Creepers never bite — they detonate.
217	      const doMelee = meleeReady && (!isRanged || isBoss) && mob.kind !== "creeper";
218	      if (doMelee) {
219	        deps.emit({ type: "mobAttacked", kind: mob.kind });
220	        deps.applyDamage(isBoss ? BOSS_MELEE_DAMAGE : mob.attackDamage);
221	        if (distanceToPlayer > 0.001) {
222	          scratchToPlayer.normalize().multiplyScalar(isBoss ? 6 : 4.2);
223	          playerVelocity.x += scratchToPlayer.x;
224	          playerVelocity.z += scratchToPlayer.z;
225	          playerVelocity.y = Math.max(playerVelocity.y, isBoss ? 4.5 : 3.4);
226	        }
227	      } else if (fireReady) {
228	        if (isBoss) fireBossSpread(state, mob, deps.emit);
229	        else fireMobArrow(state, mob, SKELETON_ARROW_DAMAGE, SKELETON_ARROW_SPEED, deps.emit);
230	      }
231	      mob.attackTimer = mob.attackCooldown;
232	    }
233	
234	    // The boss conjures minions while it is engaged with the player.
235	    if (!isDead && isBoss && activeHostile && distanceToPlayer < mob.detectRange) {
236	      tickBossSummon(state, mob, dt, deps);
237	    }
238	
239	    // A creeper lights its fuse when it gets close, then detonates — destroying
240	    // terrain and hurting the player and nearby mobs. Walk out of range while it
241	    // is primed and the fuse aborts. It dies in its own blast (dropping gunpowder
242	    // via the post-loop sweep); killing it before the fuse runs out cancels it.
243	    if (!isDead && mob.kind === "creeper") {
244	      if ((mob.fuseTimer ?? 0) > 0) {
245	        if (!activeHostile || distanceToPlayer > CREEPER_ABORT_RANGE) {
246	          mob.fuseTimer = 0;
247	        } else {
248	          mob.fuseTimer = (mob.fuseTimer ?? 0) - dt;
249	          if (mob.fuseTimer <= 0) {
250	            explode(state, mob.position.x, mob.position.y, mob.position.z, CREEPER_EXPLOSION_POWER, deps);
251	            mob.hp = 0;
252	          }
253	        }
254	      } else if (creeperFuseReady && hasLineOfSight) {
255	        mob.fuseTimer = CREEPER_FUSE_SECONDS;
256	        deps.emit({ type: "mobAttacked", kind: "creeper" }); // the hiss
257	      }
258	    }
259	
260	    // Zombies, skeletons, and creepers burn in broad daylight; the boss is immune.
261	    if (mob.hostile && mob.kind !== "spider" && mob.kind !== "boss" && daylight > HOSTILE_BURN_ABOVE_DAYLIGHT) {
262	      mob.hp -= dt * 0.8;
263	    }
264	  }
265	
266	  // Sweep the dead after the loop (descending, so splices don't shift live
267	  // indices). A post-loop sweep — not per-iteration — also catches mobs killed by
268	  // an explosion earlier in the same pass, including the creeper that just blew up.
269	  for (let i = mobs.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
270	    if (mobs[i].hp <= 0) deps.removeMobAt(i);
271	  }
272	}
273

27	export type PlayerVisuals = {
28	  /** Positions, animates, and shows/hides the body. Call once per frame. */
29	  sync(state: PlayerVisualsState, timeMs: number): void;
30	  /** Queues a one-shot arm swing (attack click); latched on the next sync. */
31	  triggerSwing(): void;
32	  /** Queues a one-shot cast flick; latched on the next sync. */
33	  triggerCast(): void;
34	  /** Queues a one-shot reel pull-back; latched on the next sync. */
35	  triggerReel(): void;
36	  /** World position of the third-person rod tip (hand anchor) — for the fishing line origin. */
37	  getRodTip(out: THREE.Vector3): THREE.Vector3;
38	  /** Recolors the body in place (skin preset change) — live-safe. */

43	export function createPlayerVisuals(scene: THREE.Scene): PlayerVisuals {
44	  const model = createPlayerModel();
45	  model.group.visible = false;
46	  scene.add(model.group);
47	
48	  let heldModel: ItemModel | null = null;
49	  let heldKey = "";
50	  let swingQueued = false;
51	  let swingStartMs = -Infinity;
52	  let castQueued = false;
53	  let castStartMs = -Infinity;
54	  let reelQueued = false;
55	  let reelStartMs = -Infinity;
56	  let wasMining = false;
57	
58	  const clearHeldModel = () => {
59	    if (!heldModel) return;
60	    model.itemHolder.remove(heldModel.object);
61	    heldModel.geometry.dispose();
62	    heldModel.material.dispose();
63	    heldModel = null;
64	    heldKey = "";
65	  };
66	
67	  const syncHeldItem = (slot: InventorySlot | undefined) => {
68	    const nextKey = slot?.id && slot.count > 0 && slot.kind ? slot.id : "";
69	    if (nextKey === heldKey) return;
70	    clearHeldModel();
71	    const built = buildItemModel(slot);
72	    if (built) {
73	      heldModel = built;
74	      heldKey = nextKey;
75	      model.itemHolder.add(built.object);
76	    }
77	  };
78	
79	  return {
80	    sync(state, timeMs) {
81	      const visible = state.cameraMode !== "first" && !state.isDead;
82	      model.group.visible = visible;
83	      if (!visible) {
84	        // Don't replay stale one-shots when the body next becomes visible.
85	        swingQueued = false;
86	        castQueued = false;
87	        reelQueued = false;
88	        return;
89	      }
90	
91	      const { player } = state;
92	      model.group.position.copy(player.position);
93	      model.group.rotation.y = player.yaw;
94	      model.head.rotation.x = player.pitch;
95	
96	      syncHeldItem(state.inventory[state.selectedSlot]);
97	
98	      const miningActive = state.mining.targetKey !== "";
99	      if (swingQueued) {
100	        swingQueued = false;
101	        swingStartMs = timeMs;
102	      }
103	      if (castQueued) {
104	        castQueued = false;
105	        castStartMs = timeMs;
106	      }
107	      if (reelQueued) {
108	        reelQueued = false;
109	        reelStartMs = timeMs;
110	      }
111	      if (miningActive && !wasMining) swingStartMs = timeMs;
112	      wasMining = miningActive;
113	
114	      const moveFactor = player.onGround ? Math.min(1, Math.hypot(player.velocity.x, player.velocity.z) / WALK_SPEED) : 0;
115	      const pose = computePlayerPose({
116	        timeMs,
117	        moveFactor,
118	        miningActive,
119	        swingStartMs,
120	        castStartMs,
121	        reelStartMs,
122	        fishingActive: state.fishing !== null
123	      });
124	      model.leftArm.rotation.x = pose.leftArmX;
125	      model.rightArm.rotation.x = pose.rightArmX;
126	      model.leftLeg.rotation.x = pose.leftLegX;
127	      model.rightLeg.rotation.x = pose.rightLegX;
128	    },
129	
130	    triggerSwing() {
131	      swingQueued = true;
132	    },
133	
134	    triggerCast() {
135	      castQueued = true;
136	    },
137	
138	    triggerReel() {
139	      reelQueued = true;
140	    },
141	
142	    getRodTip(out) {
143	      // Flush the holder's parent chain (group → right arm → holder) so the world
144	      // position is current this frame, not one frame stale. Call after sync().
145	      model.itemHolder.updateWorldMatrix(true, false);
146	      return model.itemHolder.getWorldPosition(out);
147	    },
148	
149	    setPalette(palette) {
150	      applyPalette(model, palette);
151	    },
152	
153	    dispose() {
154	      clearHeldModel();
155	      scene.remove(model.group);
156	      for (const material of model.materials) material.dispose();
157	      for (const geometry of model.geometries) geometry.dispose();
158	    }
159	  };
160	}

[]),\n    capsActive: false,\n    leftMouseHeld: overrides.leftMouseHeld ?? false,\n    pointerLocked: overrides.pointerLocked ?? false\n  };\n}\n\ndescribe(\"adventure\", () => {\n  test(\"takes damage like survival (not invulnerable)\", () => {\n    const e = makeEngine(\"adventure\");\n    const before = e.state.hearts;\n    applyDamageWithArmor(e.state, 4);\n    expect(e.state.hearts).toBe(before - 4);\n  });\n\n  test(\"can't fly\", () => {\n    const e = makeEngine(\"adventure\");\n    e.dispatch({ type: \"toggleFlight\" });\n    expect(e.state.isFlying).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  test(\"can't break a block\", () => {\n    const e = makeEngine(\"adventure\");\n    e.state.mobs = e.state.mobs.filter((mob) => !mob.hostile);\n    const p = e.state.player;\n    p.velocity.set(0, 0, 0);\n    p.pitch = -Math.PI / 2 + 0.01;\n    const origin = new THREE.Vector3(p.position.x, p.position.y + EYE_HEIGHT, p.position.z);\n    const hit = voxelRaycast(e.state.world, origin, lookDirection(p.yaw, p.pitch, new THREE.Vector3()), MINE_REACH);\n    expect(hit).not.toBeNull();\n    const { x, y, z } = hit!.hit;\n    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i += 1) e.step(1 / 60, input({ leftMouseHeld: true, pointerLocked: true }));\n    expect(e.state.world.get(x, y, z)).not.toBe(BlockId.Air); // terrain untouched\n  });\n\n  test(\"can't place a block\", () => {\n    const e = makeEngine(\"adventure\");\n    const p = e.state.player;\n    p.position.x = Math.floor(p.position.x) + 0.5;\n    p.position.z = Math.floor(p.position.z) + 0.5;\n    const px = Math.floor(p.position.x);\n    const ey = Math.floor(p.position.y + EYE_HEIGHT);\n    const pz = Math.floor(p.position.z);\n    e.state.blockChanges.set(px, ey, pz, BlockId.Air);\n    e.state.blockChanges.set(px + 1, ey, pz, BlockId.Air);\n    e.state.blockChanges.set(px + 2, ey, pz, BlockId.Air);\n    e.state.blockChanges.set(px + 3, ey, pz, BlockId.Stone);\n    p.yaw = -Math.PI / 2;\n    p.pitch = 0;\n    e.state.selectedSlot = 0;\n    e.state.inventory[0] = createSlot(\"dirt\", 10);\n\n    e.dispatch({ type: \"placeBlock\" });\n\n    expect(e.state.world.get(px + 2, ey, pz)).toBe(BlockId.Air); // nothing placed\n    expect(e.state.inventory[0].count).toBe(10); // stack untouched\n  });\n\n  test(\"combat is enabled (swing registers), unlike spectator\", () => {\n    const adventure = makeEngine(\"adventure\");\n    adventure.dispatch({ type: \"attack\" });\n    expect(adventure.consumeEvents().some((event) => event.type === \"attackSwung\")).toBe(true);\n\n    const spectator = makeEngine(\"spectator\");\n    spectator.dispatch({ type: \"attack\" });\n    expect(spectator.consumeEvents().some((event) => event.type === \"attackSwung\")).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  test(\"hostiles still hunt an adventure player\", () => {\n    const e = makeEngine(\"adventure\");\n    e.state.dayClock = 0;\n    e.state.mobs = [];\n    const p = e.state.player.position;\n    pushMob(e.state, \"zombie\", true, p.x + 1, p.y, p.z, mulberry32(7));\n    let attacked = false;\n    for (let i = 0; i < 120; i += 1) {\n      e.step(1 / 60, input({ pointerLocked: true }));\n      if (e.consumeEvents().some((event) => event.type === \"mobAttacked\")) attacked = true;\n    }\n    expect(attacked).toBe(true);\n  });\n});\n"
}

import { useState } from "react";
import { MAX_WORLD_NAME, WORLD_TYPE_PRESETS } from "@/lib/game/worlds";
import type { WorldType } from "@/lib/world";

type CreateWorldFormProps = {
  onCreate: (name: string, seed: string, worldType: WorldType) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
};

/** The new-world form: a name, a world type, and an optional seed (blank = random). */
export default function CreateWorldForm({ onCreate, onCancel }: CreateWorldFormProps) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [seed, setSeed] = useState("");
  const [worldType, setWorldType] = useState<WorldType>("default");

  return (
    <form
      className="menu-form"
      onSubmit={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        onCreate(name, seed, worldType);
      }}
    >
      <label className="menu-field">
        <span>Name</span>
        <input
          className="menu-input"
          type="text"
          value={name}
          maxLength={MAX_WORLD_NAME}
          placeholder="New World"
          autoFocus
          onChange={(event) => setName(event.target.value)}
          aria-label="World name"
        />
      </label>
      <div className="menu-field">
        <span>World Type</span>
        <div className="world-type-grid">
          {WORLD_TYPE_PRESETS.map((preset) => (
            <button
              key={preset.id}
              type="button"
              className="world-type-option"
              aria-pressed={preset.id === worldType}
              aria-label={`${preset.label} world type`}
              onClick={() => setWorldType(preset.id)}
            >
              <span className="world-type-label">{preset.label}</span>
              <span className="world-type-blurb">{preset.blurb}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      <label className="menu-field">
        <span>Seed</span>
        <input
          className="menu-input"
          type="text"
          value={seed}
          placeholder="Leave blank for random"
          onChange={(event) => setSeed(event.target.value)}
          aria-label="World seed"
        />
      </label>
      <div className="menu-form-actions">
        <button type="submit" className="mc-button">
          Create World
        </button>
        <button type="button" className="mc-button" onClick={onCancel}>
          Cancel
        </button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

7	
8	/** Short label for a world type (the default type is left unlabelled on cards). */
9	function worldTypeLabel(id: WorldType): string {
10	  return WORLD_TYPE_PRESETS.find((preset) => preset.id === id)?.label ?? id;
11	}
12	
13	type WorldSelectProps = {
14	  profile: Profile;
15	  /** Enter a world (the shell records last-played and boots it). */
16	  onPlay: (worldId: string) => void;
17	  /** Back to the profile list. */
18	  onBack: () => void;
19	};
20	
21	/** A profile's world list: pick a world, or create / rename / delete one. */
22	export default function WorldSelect({ profile, onPlay, onBack }: WorldSelectProps) {
23	  const [creating, setCreating] = useState(false);
24	  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
25	  const [editName, setEditName] = useState("");
26	  const [confirmingDeleteId, setConfirmingDeleteId] = useState<string | null>(null);
27	
28	  if (creating) {
29	    return (
30	      <MenuScreen title={`${profile.name} — New World`}>
31	        <CreateWorldForm
32	          onCreate={(name, seed, worldType) => {
33	            const world = createWorld(profile.id, name, seed, { worldType });
34	            setCreating(false);
35	            onPlay(world.id); // straight into the freshly created world
36	          }}
37	          onCancel={() => setCreating(false)}
38	        />
39	      </MenuScreen>
40	    );
41	  }
42	
43	  const worlds = worldsForProfile(profile.id);
44	
45	  return (
46	    <MenuScreen title={`${profile.name} — Worlds`}>
47	      {worlds.length === 0 ? (
48	        <p className="menu-empty">No worlds yet. Create your first world.</p>
49	      ) : (
50	        <ul className="menu-list">
51	          {worlds.map((world) => (
52	            <li key={world.id} className="menu-card">
53	              {editingId === world.id ? (
54	                <form
55	                  className="menu-rename"
56	                  onSubmit={(event) => {
57	                    event.preventDefault();
58	                    renameWorld(world.id, editName);
59	                    setEditingId(null); // re-render re-reads the manifest
60	                  }}
61	                >
62	                  <input
63	                    className="menu-input"
64	                    value={editName}
65	                    maxLength={MAX_WORLD_NAME}
66	                    autoFocus
67	                    aria-label="Rename world"
68	                    onChange={(event) => setEditName(event.target.value)}
69	                  />
70	                  <button type="submit" className="mc-button">
71	                    Save
72	                  </button>
73	                  <button type="button" className="mc-button" onClick={() => setEditingId(null)}>
74	                    Cancel
75	                  </button>
76	                </form>
77	              ) : confirmingDeleteId === world.id ? (
78	                <div className="menu-confirm">
79	                  <span>Delete “{world.name}”? This cannot be undone.</span>
80	                  <div className="menu-confirm-actions">
81	                    <button
82	                      className="mc-button danger"
83	                      onClick={() => {
84	                        deleteWorld(world.id);
85	                        setConfirmingDeleteId(null); // re-render re-reads the manifest
86	                      }}
87	                    >
88	                      Delete
89	                    </button>
90	                    <button className="mc-button" onClick={() => setConfirmingDeleteId(null)}>
91	                      Cancel
92	                    </button>
93	                  </div>
94	                </div>
95	              ) : (
96	                <>
97	                  <button className="menu-card-play" data-testid={`world-${world.id}`} onClick={() => onPlay(world.id)}>
98	                    <span className="menu-card-name">{world.name}</span>
99	                    <span className="menu-card-sub">
100	                      {world.worldType !== "default" ? `${worldTypeLabel(world.worldType)} · ` : ""}Seed {world.seed}
101	                    </span>
102	                  </button>
103	                  <div className="menu-card-actions">
104	                    <button

  "content": "import { describe, expect, test } from \"bun:test\";\nimport { BlockId, collidesAt } from \"@/lib/world\";\nimport { MAX_HEARTS, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT } from \"@/lib/game/config\";\nimport { GameEngine } from \"@/lib/game/engine/GameEngine\";\nimport type { GameMode } from \"@/lib/game/gameModes\";\n\nfunction mulberry32(seed: number): () => number {\n  let t = seed >>> 0;\n  return () => {\n    t += 0x6d2b79f5;\n    let r = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), 1 | t);\n    r ^= r + Math.imul(r ^ (r >>> 7), 61 | r);\n    return ((r ^ (r >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;\n  };\n}\n\nfunction makeEngine(gameMode: GameMode): GameEngine {\n  return new GameEngine({ seed: 1337, gameMode, rng: mulberry32(42), worldSize: { x: 64, y: 150, z: 64 } });\n}\n\ndescribe(\"setGameMode\", () => {\n  test(\"switches mode and clears queued hazard damage + refills bars\", () => {\n    const e = makeEngine(\"survival\");\n    e.state.hearts = 4;\n    e.state.timers.lavaBurnTimer = 2;\n    e.state.timers.drownTimer = 1;\n\n    e.dispatch({ type: \"setGameMode\", mode: \"creative\" });\n\n    expect(e.state.gameMode).toBe(\"creative\");\n    expect(e.state.hearts).toBe(MAX_HEARTS);\n    expect(e.state.timers.lavaBurnTimer).toBe(0);\n    expect(e.state.timers.drownTimer).toBe(0);\n    expect(e.state.isFlying).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  test(\"entering spectator forces flight; leaving it grounds the player\", () => {\n    const e = makeEngine(\"survival\");\n    e.dispatch({ type: \"setGameMode\", mode: \"spectator\" });\n    expect(e.state.isFlying).toBe(true);\n    e.dispatch({ type: \"setGameMode\", mode: \"adventure\" });\n    expect(e.state.isFlying).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  test(\"a same-mode switch is a no-op\", () => {\n    const e = makeEngine(\"creative\");\n    e.state.isFlying = true;\n    e.dispatch({ type: \"setGameMode\", mode: \"creative\" });\n    expect(e.state.isFlying).toBe(true); // untouched — not reset to false\n  });\n\n  test(\"leaving spectator lifts the player out of solid terrain\", () => {\n    const e = makeEngine(\"spectator\");\n    const p = e.state.player.position;\n    const px = Math.floor(p.x);\n    const py = Math.floor(p.y);\n    const pz = Math.floor(p.z);\n    // Bury the player in stone (legal while noclipping).\n    for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx += 1) for (let dy = 0; dy <= 2; dy += 1) for (let dz = -1; dz <= 1; dz += 1) e.state.blockChanges.set(px + dx, py + dy, pz + dz, BlockId.Stone);\n    expect(collidesAt(e.state.world, e.state.player.position, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT)).toBe(true);\n\n    e.dispatch({ type: \"setGameMode\", mode: \"survival\" });\n\n    expect(collidesAt(e.state.world, e.state.player.position, PLAYER_HALF_WIDTH, PLAYER_HEIGHT)).toBe(false);\n  });\n\n  test(\"the switched mode persists through serialize/restore\", () => {\n    const e = makeEngine(\"survival\");\n    e.dispatch({ type: \"setGameMode\", mode: \"creative\" });\n    const restored = new GameEngine({ save: e.serialize(), rng: mulberry32(1), worldSize: { x: 64, y: 150, z: 64 } });\n    expect(restored.state.gameMode).toBe(\"creative\");\n  });\n});\n"
}
